senses.english: machine (such as a car) that is used to carry things
senses.exampleEnglish: Because the mountain road was narrow, we chose a smaller vehicle that could turn around more easily.
senses.exampleChinese: 因为山路狭窄，我们选了一辆更容易掉头的小型车辆。

senses.english: a way of expressing or communicating something
senses.exampleEnglish: The magazine became a vehicle for local writers who wanted to share stories that larger publishers often ignored.
senses.exampleChinese: 这本杂志成为当地作家的表达平台，他们想分享大出版社常常忽略的故事。

senses.english: a person who is trained to gain knowledge by making predictions, testing them, and developing theories
senses.exampleEnglish: The scientist repeated the experiment several times before she was confident that the results were reliable.
senses.exampleChinese: 这位科学家多次重复实验后，才确信结果可靠。

senses.english: way to get from one place to another place
senses.exampleEnglish: We took a different route to the station because the main bridge was closed for repairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 由于主桥封闭维修，我们换了一条路线去车站。

senses.english: to send something along a particular route
senses.exampleEnglish: The company will route urgent calls through its main office so that customers can receive help during the holiday.
senses.exampleChinese: 公司将把紧急来电转接到总部，以便顾客在假日期间也能获得帮助。

senses.english: to join two or more things together to limit their freedom
senses.exampleEnglish: They used strong rope to bind the wooden poles together before lifting the frame into position.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们先用结实的绳子把木杆绑在一起，再把框架抬到位。

senses.english: to make someone legally or morally required to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: The agreement will bind both companies to the same safety standards, even if the cost of production increases.
senses.exampleChinese: 这份协议将约束两家公司遵守相同的安全标准，即使生产成本增加也不例外。

senses.english: to fasten the pages of a book together inside a cover
senses.exampleEnglish: The students learned to bind their illustrated stories into small books that they could take home and share.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生们学习把配有插图的故事装订成小书，带回家与人分享。

senses.english: to be a member of a particular group and feel welcomed
senses.exampleEnglish: Although she had recently joined the club, everyone made her feel that she really did belong there.
senses.exampleChinese: 虽然她刚加入俱乐部，大家却都让她觉得自己真正属于这里。

senses.english: to be owned by someone
senses.exampleEnglish: These tools belong to our neighbour, so we should clean them carefully before taking them back this evening.
senses.exampleChinese: 这些工具属于邻居，所以今晚归还之前，我们应该仔细清理干净。

senses.english: to be in the right or suitable place
senses.exampleEnglish: The spare keys belong in this drawer, where everyone in the family can find them without asking for help.
senses.exampleChinese: 备用钥匙应该放在这个抽屉里，这样家里每个人都能自行找到。

senses.english: the particular quality of food or drink that can be sensed by a person's mouth
senses.exampleEnglish: The soup had a much richer taste after we added fresh herbs and cooked it slowly.
senses.exampleChinese: 加入新鲜香草并慢慢熬煮后，这道汤的味道浓郁了许多。

senses.english: to try a small amount of food or drink
senses.exampleEnglish: You should taste the sauce before adding more salt, because the cheese already gives it quite a strong flavour.
senses.exampleChinese: 加盐之前应该尝一下酱汁，因为奶酪已经让它有相当浓的味道。

senses.english: to have a particular flavour
senses.exampleEnglish: The soup may taste sweeter than usual because we used fresh carrots instead of the vegetables in the original recipe.
senses.exampleChinese: 汤的味道可能比平时更甜，因为我们用了新鲜胡萝卜，替换了原食谱中的蔬菜。

senses.english: the kinds of things a person likes or chooses
senses.exampleEnglish: Her taste in music changed after she joined a choir and began listening to songs from different countries.
senses.exampleChinese: 她加入合唱团、开始听不同国家的歌曲后，音乐品味发生了变化。

senses.english: to notice a flavour in something you eat or drink
senses.exampleEnglish: I could taste the lemon in the cake, although the recipe used only a small amount of juice.
senses.exampleChinese: 我能尝出蛋糕里的柠檬味，尽管食谱只用了少量柠檬汁。

senses.english: the time from when the sun goes down on this day to when it comes up the following morning
senses.exampleEnglish: We should finish packing tonight so that we can leave for the airport without rushing tomorrow morning.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们今晚应该收拾好行李，这样明早就能从容地去机场。

senses.english: the evening or night of the present day
senses.exampleEnglish: Tonight is our last chance to see the exhibition before the museum closes for several weeks of repairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 今晚是我们参观展览的最后机会，之后博物馆将关闭数周进行维修。

senses.english: style of dress or activity popular at some time
senses.exampleEnglish: She follows fashion closely, but she prefers clothes that remain useful long after a particular trend has passed.
senses.exampleChinese: 她密切关注时尚，但更喜欢某种潮流过后仍然实用的衣服。

senses.english: to make or shape something, often using simple materials
senses.exampleEnglish: The children will fashion small boats from recycled materials before testing which designs can carry the most weight across the pool.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们将用回收材料制作小船，再测试哪种设计能载最多重量过池。

senses.english: possibility of getting hurt, damaged, or killed
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide explained the danger of walking near the cliff, especially when the path was wet.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游解释了靠近悬崖行走的危险，尤其是在小路湿滑的时候。

senses.english: a weapon designed to break apart very suddenly and violently
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum displayed a damaged bomb case to explain how the town had experienced the war.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆展示了一个受损的炸弹外壳，用来说明这座城镇在战争中的遭遇。

senses.english: to attack a place using bombs
senses.exampleEnglish: The film explains why planes were sent to bomb the railway, while also showing the effects on nearby families.
senses.exampleChinese: 电影解释了为何派飞机轰炸铁路，也展示了附近家庭受到的影响。

senses.chinese: 彻底失败的作品或活动
senses.english: a performance or product that fails very badly
senses.exampleEnglish: The director feared that his new play would be a bomb after so few people bought tickets for opening night.
senses.exampleChinese: 首演之夜买票的人很少，导演担心自己的新剧会彻底失败。

senses.english: large group of soldiers organized to fight in wars
senses.exampleEnglish: After leaving the army, my uncle trained as an engineer and helped build bridges in remote areas.
senses.exampleChinese: 离开军队后，我叔叔接受了工程师培训，帮助偏远地区修建桥梁。

senses.english: involving the chance of hurt or damage; risky
senses.exampleEnglish: Cycling along that road can be dangerous because drivers cannot see clearly around the sharp bend.
senses.exampleChinese: 在那条路上骑车可能很危险，因为司机无法看清急弯另一侧的情况。

senses.english: to reduce the size, amount, or number of something
senses.exampleEnglish: We hope the new bus service will decrease the number of cars entering the city centre each morning.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们希望新的公交服务能减少每天早晨进入市中心的汽车数量。

senses.english: a reduction in size, amount, or number
senses.exampleEnglish: A decrease in traffic made the village centre quieter, allowing more people to enjoy the cafes beside the square.
senses.exampleChinese: 车流量下降让村中心更安静，更多人能享受广场旁的咖啡馆。

senses.english: to make someone feel unhappy or upset
senses.exampleEnglish: He did not mean to hurt her feelings, but his careless comment made her feel unwelcome.
senses.exampleChinese: 他并不想伤害她的感情，但他那句随意的话让她觉得自己不受欢迎。

senses.english: to cause physical pain or feel pain
senses.exampleEnglish: My shoulder began to hurt after carrying the heavy bag, so I moved some books into a smaller backpack.
senses.exampleChinese: 提着沉重的包后，我的肩膀开始疼，于是把一些书装进较小的背包。

senses.english: upset by what someone has said or done
senses.exampleEnglish: She felt hurt when her suggestion was dismissed without discussion, although she tried to explain why it mattered.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的建议未经讨论就被否定，这让她很难过，但她仍努力解释它的重要性。

senses.english: emotional pain caused by unkind treatment or events
senses.exampleEnglish: The apology did not remove all the hurt, but it helped them begin a more honest conversation about their friendship.
senses.exampleChinese: 道歉没有消除全部伤痛，但帮助他们开始更坦诚地讨论友谊。

senses.english: group chosen to make decisions about something
senses.exampleEnglish: The local council asked residents for their opinions before deciding where to build the new sports centre.
senses.exampleChinese: 地方委员会在决定新体育中心的选址之前，征求了居民的意见。

senses.english: a person whose job is to correct and make changes to the contents of a book or magazine
senses.exampleEnglish: The editor suggested a clearer opening paragraph so that readers would understand the purpose of the article immediately.
senses.exampleChinese: 编辑建议把开头一段写得更清楚，让读者马上理解文章的目的。

senses.english: a computer program used to change text, pictures, or other material
senses.exampleEnglish: The photo editor lets you adjust the light and colours without changing the original image stored on your computer.
senses.exampleChinese: 照片编辑软件让你调整亮度和颜色，而不改变电脑中保存的原始图像。

senses.english: in the manner that is usual or ordinary
senses.exampleEnglish: We normally walk to school, although we take the bus when the weather is particularly wet or cold.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们通常步行上学，不过遇到特别阴雨或寒冷的天气就乘公交车。

senses.english: the ability to see
senses.exampleEnglish: Her grandfather's sight had become weaker, so she bought him books with larger print that were easier to read.
senses.exampleChinese: 她祖父的视力变差了，于是她给他买了更容易阅读的大字版书籍。

senses.english: something that you can see, especially something noticeable
senses.exampleEnglish: The harbour was a beautiful sight at sunrise, when the boats were still and the surrounding streets were quiet.
senses.exampleChinese: 日出时的港口景色很美，船只静静停着，周围的街道也很安静。

senses.english: to create or be produced or bring into existence
senses.exampleEnglish: The roof panels generate enough electricity to power the building during most of the summer, reducing its energy costs.
senses.exampleChinese: 屋顶上的面板在夏季大部分时间能产生足够的电力供大楼使用，从而降低能源费用。

senses.english: something given to another for a reason; present
senses.exampleEnglish: We chose a small handmade gift that would remind our host of the enjoyable week we had spent together.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们选了一件手工制作的小礼物，好让主人记起一起度过的愉快一周。

senses.english: a natural ability to do something well
senses.exampleEnglish: She has a gift for explaining difficult ideas through examples that make sense to people with little previous knowledge.
senses.exampleChinese: 她有讲解复杂概念的天赋，能用缺少相关知识的人也听得懂的例子说明。

senses.english: to give something to someone as a gift
senses.exampleEnglish: The artist decided to gift the painting to the school, where it could be enjoyed by students for many years.
senses.exampleChinese: 画家决定把这幅画赠给学校，让学生们在未来多年都能欣赏它。

senses.english: act of taking something to a person or place
senses.exampleEnglish: The shop offered free delivery because the furniture was too large for us to carry home ourselves.
senses.exampleChinese: 商店提供免费配送，因为这些家具太大，我们无法自己搬回家。

senses.english: the birth of a baby
senses.exampleEnglish: The hospital arranged a quiet room for the family after the delivery, allowing the parents some time together.
senses.exampleChinese: 分娩后，医院为这一家人安排了安静的房间，让父母能相处一会儿。

senses.chinese: 演讲或表演的表达方式
senses.english: the way a speech or performance is given
senses.exampleEnglish: Her delivery was calm and clear, which helped the audience follow an argument that involved several unfamiliar ideas.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的表达平静清晰，帮助观众理解了包含几个陌生概念的论证。

senses.english: to say that something is not true
senses.exampleEnglish: The manager did not deny that mistakes had been made, but she promised to explain what had happened.
senses.exampleChinese: 经理没有否认曾出现错误，但她承诺会解释事情的经过。

senses.english: to refuse to give or allow something
senses.exampleEnglish: The hotel cannot deny guests access to their belongings simply because there is a disagreement about the final bill.
senses.exampleChinese: 酒店不能仅因最终账单有争议，就拒绝让客人取回自己的物品。

senses.english: person invited to visit or stay in someone's home
senses.exampleEnglish: We asked each guest to mention any food allergies before the meal so that everyone could eat safely.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们请每位客人在用餐前说明食物过敏情况，以便大家安心进餐。

senses.english: invited to appear or work somewhere for a short time
senses.exampleEnglish: A guest lecturer will explain how local history can be studied through photographs as well as official written records.
senses.exampleChinese: 一位客座讲师将讲解如何结合照片和官方文字记录研究地方史。

senses.english: any person; anyone
senses.exampleEnglish: If anybody needs help with the application form, a member of staff will be available near the entrance.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果有人需要填写申请表方面的帮助，入口附近会有工作人员提供协助。

senses.english: room for sleeping usually with a bed
senses.exampleEnglish: We turned the spare bedroom into a study after discovering that we both needed somewhere quiet to work.
senses.exampleChinese: 发现我们都需要安静的工作空间后，我们把空余的卧室改成了书房。

senses.english: to use someone's exact words in your writing or speech
senses.exampleEnglish: If you quote a sentence from another writer, remember to name the author and show where it came from.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果引用其他作者的句子，记得注明作者，并说明出处。

senses.english: to tell someone the expected price of work or goods
senses.exampleEnglish: The builder will quote a price after checking how much damage has been caused to the roof by the storm.
senses.exampleChinese: 建筑工人检查风暴给屋顶造成的损坏后，将报出维修价格。

senses.english: words repeated exactly from something someone said or wrote
senses.exampleEnglish: The article began with a quote from a local resident, which immediately showed why the proposed changes mattered.
senses.exampleChinese: 文章以一位当地居民的话开头，立即说明拟议改革为何重要。

senses.english: a statement of the expected price of work or goods
senses.exampleEnglish: We asked for a written quote before agreeing to the repairs, so that we would understand all the likely costs.
senses.exampleChinese: 同意维修前，我们要求书面报价，以便了解所有可能费用。

senses.english: to rise gradually and steadily to a higher point
senses.exampleEnglish: We began to climb the hill before sunrise so that we could reach the top before the heat became uncomfortable.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们日出前就开始爬山，希望在暑热难耐之前到达山顶。

senses.english: to increase steadily in number or amount
senses.exampleEnglish: Ticket prices continued to climb as the festival approached, so we were glad that we had booked several months earlier.
senses.exampleChinese: 随着节日临近，票价不断上涨，因此我们很庆幸几个月前就订好了。

senses.english: an act of going up a hill or other steep place
senses.exampleEnglish: The final climb was tiring, but the view from the top made us forget how slowly we had walked.
senses.exampleChinese: 最后一段攀登很累，但山顶的景色让我们忘记了先前走得多慢。

senses.english: in the most important ways even if not completely true
senses.exampleEnglish: The two machines are basically the same, although the newer model is quieter and uses slightly less electricity.
senses.exampleChinese: 这两台机器基本相同，不过较新的型号更安静，耗电量也略低。

senses.english: use of physical force to harm someone or damage something
senses.exampleEnglish: The community organised a peaceful meeting to discuss how better youth services might help reduce violence in the area.
senses.exampleChinese: 社区组织了一场和平集会，讨论改善青少年服务如何帮助减少当地暴力事件。

senses.english: an official who heads a government department
senses.exampleEnglish: The education minister visited the school to hear how the new classrooms had changed the students' learning experience.
senses.exampleChinese: 教育部长到校访问，了解新教室如何改变了学生的学习体验。

senses.english: a religious leader who leads services in some Christian churches
senses.exampleEnglish: The minister welcomed everyone to the service, including visitors who had never attended a meeting at that church before.
senses.exampleChinese: 牧师欢迎所有人参加礼拜，包括从未到过这座教堂的访客。

senses.english: mostly; usually; being the largest part
senses.exampleEnglish: The village depends mainly on visitors in summer, so several small shops close during the quieter winter months.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个村庄主要依靠夏季游客，因此几家小店在较清闲的冬季会关门。

senses.english: part of the face used for eating and talking
senses.exampleEnglish: He covered his mouth when he coughed, then moved away from the crowded table to get some fresh air.
senses.exampleChinese: 他咳嗽时捂住嘴，然后离开拥挤的餐桌去透透气。

senses.english: the opening through which something enters or leaves a place
senses.exampleEnglish: Small boats gathered near the mouth of the river, waiting for the tide to make the journey upstream easier.
senses.exampleChinese: 小船聚集在河口附近，等待潮水让逆流而上的航程更容易。

senses.english: to form words with your lips without making a sound
senses.exampleEnglish: Across the crowded room, she tried to mouth the words slowly so that her friend could understand the message.
senses.exampleChinese: 隔着拥挤的房间，她试着慢慢做口型，让朋友能明白信息。

senses.english: a loud or unpleasant sound
senses.exampleEnglish: We moved our meeting to a smaller room because the noise from the building work made conversation difficult.
senses.exampleChinese: 由于施工噪音让交谈变得困难，我们把会议转移到一间较小的房间。

senses.english: that way that something happens or is done
senses.exampleEnglish: She explained the problem in a calm manner, which helped everyone focus on finding a practical solution.
senses.exampleChinese: 她以平静的方式解释问题，这有助于大家集中精力寻找可行的解决办法。

senses.english: polite ways of behaving towards other people, usually in the plural
senses.exampleEnglish: Good manners helped the children share the table comfortably, even though several of them had not met before.
senses.exampleChinese: 良好的礼貌让孩子们能自在地同桌用餐，尽管其中几个人以前没见过。

senses.english: a weapon that shoots small metal objects down a metal tube
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum keeps the old gun behind protective glass and explains its history without allowing visitors to handle it.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆把那支旧枪放在防护玻璃后，并介绍其历史，不让游客触碰。

senses.english: shape with four sides of equal length sides and four right (90°) angles
senses.exampleEnglish: The children measured each side of the square carefully to check whether all four lengths were exactly equal.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们仔细测量正方形的每一条边，检查四条边的长度是否完全相等。

senses.english: having four equal sides and four right angles
senses.exampleEnglish: We chose a square table for the small room because it fitted neatly into the space beside the window.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们为小房间选了方桌，因为它正好能放进窗旁的空间。

senses.english: an open public area in a town, usually surrounded by buildings
senses.exampleEnglish: The market moved into the main square, where shoppers could walk between the stalls without worrying about passing cars.
senses.exampleChinese: 集市搬到了主广场，购物者可以在摊位间行走，不必担心来往汽车。

senses.english: the number produced by multiplying a number by itself
senses.exampleEnglish: To find the area of this square, calculate the square of the length marked along its lower side.
senses.exampleChinese: 求这个正方形的面积时，要计算其下边所标长度的平方。

senses.english: to multiply a number by itself
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher asked us to square each number first, then compare the answers with the results in the table.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师让我们先把每个数平方，再把答案与表中的结果比较。

senses.english: particular time when something important or special happens
senses.exampleEnglish: They saved their best dishes for a special occasion, such as the evening when the whole family finally gathered together.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们把最好的餐具留到特别的日子使用，比如全家终于团聚的那个晚上。

senses.english: a particular event or an opportunity to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: The celebration gave us an occasion to thank the volunteers who had quietly supported the project throughout the year.
senses.exampleChinese: 庆典给我们机会感谢整年默默支持项目的志愿者。

senses.english: well-known or easily recognized
senses.exampleEnglish: The path looked familiar because we had followed the same route on a school trip several years earlier.
senses.exampleChinese: 这条小路看起来很熟悉，因为几年前学校组织旅行时，我们走过同样的路线。

senses.chinese: 过分随便的；过于亲近的
senses.english: behaving too informally towards someone you do not know well
senses.exampleEnglish: The new employee felt uncomfortable when a customer became too familiar and began asking questions about her private life.
senses.exampleChinese: 一位顾客过分随便、开始问她私生活的问题时，新员工感到不舒服。

senses.english: to not listen to, look at, or pay attention to
senses.exampleEnglish: We should not ignore the customer's concerns simply because the problem has not been reported by anyone else.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们不应仅仅因为别人还没有报告这个问题，就忽视这位顾客的担忧。

senses.english: to damage something so badly that it no longer exists
senses.exampleEnglish: A severe storm could destroy the temporary shelter, so the volunteers strengthened its roof before the bad weather arrived.
senses.exampleChinese: 强烈风暴可能毁掉临时住所，因此志愿者在恶劣天气来临前加固了屋顶。

senses.english: event or a set of events, often unpleasant ones
senses.exampleEnglish: The broken window became a complicated affair when the neighbours disagreed about who should pay for the repairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 邻居们对谁该支付维修费意见不一，让窗户破损这件事变得复杂起来。

senses.english: a sexual or romantic relationship, especially one outside marriage
senses.exampleEnglish: In the novel, a secret affair causes tension between two families who have been close friends for many years.
senses.exampleChinese: 小说中，一段秘密私情让两个多年来交好的家庭产生了矛盾。

senses.english: matters connected with public or private life, often in the plural
senses.exampleEnglish: She follows international affairs closely because changes abroad can affect the small business that her family runs at home.
senses.exampleChinese: 她密切关注国际事务，因为国外的变化可能影响家人在本地经营的小企业。

senses.english: related to the people of a country; not military/criminal
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition explains how civil rights campaigns changed people's lives and encouraged wider participation in public decisions.
senses.exampleChinese: 这场展览解释了公民权利运动如何改变人们的生活，并鼓励更多人参与公共决策。

senses.english: polite even when you do not feel friendly
senses.exampleEnglish: They managed to remain civil during the meeting, although both sides were frustrated by the lack of progress.
senses.exampleChinese: 尽管双方都因进展缓慢而沮丧，但开会时他们仍设法保持礼貌。

senses.english: relating to legal disagreements between people rather than crimes
senses.exampleEnglish: The lawyer explained that this was a civil case, since it concerned a disagreement about a contract rather than a crime.
senses.exampleChinese: 律师解释说这是民事案件，因为争议涉及合同，而不是犯罪。

senses.english: to find a certain place, position, or location of something
senses.exampleEnglish: We used the map to locate the nearest railway station after discovering that our phone batteries were almost empty.
senses.exampleChinese: 发现手机快没电后，我们用地图寻找最近的火车站。

senses.english: to put or establish something in a particular place
senses.exampleEnglish: The company plans to locate its new office near the station, making the journey easier for employees without cars.
senses.exampleChinese: 公司计划把新办公室设在车站附近，方便没有汽车的员工通勤。

senses.english: person who belongs to and has rights in a country
senses.exampleEnglish: As a citizen, she believed it was important to understand local issues before deciding how to vote.
senses.exampleChinese: 作为一名公民，她认为在决定如何投票之前了解当地议题十分重要。

senses.english: a measure of how hot or cold something is (e.g., the weather)
senses.exampleEnglish: The temperature inside the greenhouse rose quickly, so we opened the windows to protect the young plants.
senses.exampleChinese: 温室里的温度迅速上升，于是我们打开窗户，保护幼小的植物。

senses.english: soft yellow metal that is very valuable
senses.exampleEnglish: The ring was made of gold, but its real value to her came from the family memories it carried.
senses.exampleChinese: 这枚戒指由黄金制成，但对她来说，它真正的价值在于承载的家庭回忆。

senses.english: the first prize in a competition, especially a sports event
senses.exampleEnglish: Winning gold was not her only aim; she also wanted to improve the time she had achieved the previous season.
senses.exampleChinese: 赢得金牌不是她唯一的目标；她还希望提高上个赛季取得的成绩。

senses.english: made of gold or having its yellow colour
senses.exampleEnglish: The gold lettering on the dark cover made the book look special, even though its design was otherwise simple.
senses.exampleChinese: 深色封面上的金色字样让书看起来特别，尽管其他设计很简单。

senses.english: of or relating to a particular country; of or relating to the home and family
senses.exampleEnglish: The airport's domestic flights leave from a smaller terminal, while international passengers use the main building next door.
senses.exampleChinese: 机场的国内航班从较小的航站楼出发，国际旅客则使用隔壁的主楼。

senses.english: relating to the home and family
senses.exampleEnglish: Sharing domestic tasks more fairly gave everyone extra time to relax, rather than leaving all the cleaning to one person.
senses.exampleChinese: 更公平地分担家务让每个人都有额外时间休息，而不是让一个人包揽清洁。

senses.english: kept by people rather than living wild
senses.exampleEnglish: Domestic animals may depend on people for food and shelter, even when they are allowed to spend time outside.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使可以在户外活动，家养动物仍可能依赖人提供食物和住所。

senses.english: an amount of things carried by a person or vehicle
senses.exampleEnglish: The driver checked that the heavy load was secure before beginning the long journey along the coast.
senses.exampleChinese: 司机在开始漫长的沿海行程前，检查了沉重的货物是否固定牢靠。

senses.english: an amount of work or responsibility someone has
senses.exampleEnglish: Her teaching load became lighter when another instructor joined the course, allowing her more time to prepare individual feedback.
senses.exampleChinese: 另一位教师加入后，她的教学任务减轻了，能有更多时间准备个别反馈。

senses.english: to put things into a vehicle or container
senses.exampleEnglish: We will load the equipment into the van tonight so that the group can leave early tomorrow morning.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们今晚会把设备装进货车，让队伍明早能够早点出发。

senses.english: to put a program or data into a computer's memory
senses.exampleEnglish: The page may take longer to load when several people are using the same connection to watch videos.
senses.exampleChinese: 几个人共用网络看视频时，网页加载可能花更长时间。

senses.english: a feeling of being sure that something exists or is true
senses.exampleEnglish: Her belief that everyone could improve with practice encouraged the less confident students to keep trying new tasks.
senses.exampleChinese: 她相信每个人都能通过练习进步，这鼓励了信心不足的学生继续尝试新任务。

senses.english: group of soldiers; an organized group
senses.exampleEnglish: A troop of soldiers helped carry supplies across the river after the storm damaged the village bridge.
senses.exampleChinese: 暴风雨损坏村里的桥后，一支部队帮助把物资运过河。

senses.english: to walk somewhere together as a group
senses.exampleEnglish: The children began to troop back into the classroom once the teacher announced that the afternoon break was over.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师宣布下午休息结束后，孩子们开始成群结队回到教室。

senses.english: of practical use of machines or science in industry
senses.exampleEnglish: We postponed the online meeting because a technical problem prevented several participants from hearing the discussion clearly.
senses.exampleChinese: 由于技术问题导致几位参与者无法清楚听到讨论，我们推迟了线上会议。

senses.english: relating to the special skills needed for an activity
senses.exampleEnglish: The piece presents several technical challenges for young musicians, although its main melody sounds quite simple to the audience.
senses.exampleChinese: 这首曲子给年轻音乐家带来几项技巧挑战，虽然观众听来主旋律相当简单。

senses.english: to make someone remember something
senses.exampleEnglish: Please remind me to return the library books tomorrow, because I do not want to pay another late fee.
senses.exampleChinese: 请提醒我明天归还图书馆的书，因为我不想再付逾期费了。

senses.english: an agreement about what people will do
senses.exampleEnglish: We made an arrangement with our neighbours to water each other's plants whenever one family was away on holiday.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们和邻居达成约定，一家外出度假时，另一家就帮忙浇花。

senses.english: plans and preparations for something to happen
senses.exampleEnglish: The travel arrangements took longer than expected because several people needed to arrive on different days and leave at different times.
senses.exampleChinese: 行程安排比预期更费时，因为几个人需要在不同日期抵达，并在不同时段离开。

senses.english: the way things are positioned or organised
senses.exampleEnglish: The new arrangement of desks made group discussions easier, while still giving each student enough room to work alone.
senses.exampleChinese: 新的课桌布置让小组讨论更容易，同时仍给每位学生足够的独立工作空间。

senses.english: a version of a piece of music adapted for particular performers
senses.exampleEnglish: The choir performed a new arrangement of a familiar song, using only voices instead of the instruments in the original.
senses.exampleChinese: 合唱团演唱了熟悉歌曲的新改编版，仅用人声代替原版的乐器。

senses.english: outer layer of an animal's or human's body
senses.exampleEnglish: Her skin felt dry after the long flight, so she was glad to wash her face when she reached the hotel.
senses.exampleChinese: 长途飞行后她觉得皮肤干燥，所以到酒店后能洗把脸让她很高兴。

senses.english: the thin outer covering of fruit or other food
senses.exampleEnglish: The potatoes have a very thin skin, so we washed them carefully rather than removing it before cooking.
senses.exampleChinese: 这些土豆的皮很薄，因此我们仔细洗净，没有在烹饪前去皮。

senses.english: to remove the outer covering of an animal or food
senses.exampleEnglish: The recipe asks you to skin the tomatoes after briefly warming them, which makes the outer layer easier to remove.
senses.exampleChinese: 食谱要求把西红柿稍微加热后去皮，这样外皮更容易剥掉。

senses.english: a place where people who have committed serious crimes are held
senses.exampleEnglish: The visitor learned how education programmes in prison could help people prepare for life after their release.
senses.exampleChinese: 这位访客了解到，监狱里的教育项目可以帮助人们为获释后的生活作准备。

senses.english: to change from one thing to another; (n) a thing you move to change from one thing to another
senses.exampleEnglish: We decided to switch to a later train because the earlier service did not stop at our destination.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们决定改乘稍晚的火车，因为较早那班不在我们的目的地停靠。

senses.english: a small device used to turn electricity or equipment on or off
senses.exampleEnglish: The light switch is beside the door, where you can reach it easily without crossing the room in the dark.
senses.exampleChinese: 灯的开关在门旁，不必摸黑穿过房间就能轻松够到。

senses.english: a change from one thing to another
senses.exampleEnglish: The switch to reusable containers reduced waste, although staff needed time to learn the new cleaning routine.
senses.exampleChinese: 改用可重复使用的容器减少了垃圾，不过员工需要时间学习新的清洗流程。

senses.english: to get or earn something by thinking or working
senses.exampleEnglish: Students acquire useful research skills when they compare several sources instead of accepting the first answer they find.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生比较多个来源，而不直接接受找到的第一个答案时，就能获得有用的研究技能。

senses.english: concerning (usually large) companies
senses.exampleEnglish: The company revised its corporate policy after employees asked for clearer rules about working from home during the week.
senses.exampleChinese: 员工要求明确每周居家办公的规定后，公司修订了企业政策。

senses.english: in a reasonable way; between a little and very much
senses.exampleEnglish: The instructions were fairly clear, although we still needed help with the final stage of assembling the desk.
senses.exampleChinese: 说明相当清楚，不过我们在组装书桌的最后一步仍然需要帮助。

senses.english: in a way that treats people equally and reasonably
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher wanted to judge each project fairly, so she used the same clear criteria for every group.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师想公平地评价每个项目，因此对每组都使用相同的明确标准。

senses.english: hard material that trees are made of and is used for building and fuel
senses.exampleEnglish: We used wood from an old table to build shelves, which saved money and reduced the amount of waste.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们用一张旧桌子的木材制作架子，这既省了钱，也减少了废料。

senses.english: an area of land covered with trees
senses.exampleEnglish: A small wood separates the village from the main road, helping to reduce noise from traffic during the day.
senses.exampleChinese: 一片小树林把村庄与主路隔开，有助于减少白天的交通噪音。

senses.english: to take part with others in doing something
senses.exampleEnglish: Everyone was encouraged to participate in the discussion, including those who had not spoken at the previous meeting.
senses.exampleChinese: 大家都受到鼓励参与讨论，包括那些在上次会议中没有发言的人。

senses.english: very difficult to do or deal with
senses.exampleEnglish: It was a tough decision to leave the team, but she needed more time to care for her family.
senses.exampleChinese: 离开团队是一个艰难的决定，但她需要更多时间照顾家人。

senses.english: able to deal with difficult conditions without giving up
senses.exampleEnglish: She became tougher after working through several setbacks, but she still valued advice from people she trusted.
senses.exampleChinese: 经历几次挫折后，她变得更坚强，但仍珍视信任之人的建议。

senses.english: strong and difficult to break or damage
senses.exampleEnglish: The bag is made from tough fabric that can survive daily use, even when it carries heavy books.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个包用结实面料制成，即使装着沉重的书，也能经受日常使用。

senses.english: difficult to cut or chew when used about food
senses.exampleEnglish: The meat was rather tough because it had been cooked too quickly, although the sauce had a pleasant flavour.
senses.exampleChinese: 肉因为做得太快而有些难嚼，不过酱汁味道不错。

senses.english: to damage or divide something by pulling it apart
senses.exampleEnglish: Be careful not to tear the old letter when you unfold it, because the paper has become very thin.
senses.exampleChinese: 展开这封旧信时小心别把它撕破，因为纸已经变得很薄了。

senses.english: a drop of liquid that comes from the eye when someone cries
senses.exampleEnglish: A tear ran down her cheek as she read the letter from the friend she had not seen for years.
senses.exampleChinese: 她读着多年未见的朋友寄来的信，一滴眼泪顺着脸颊流下。

senses.english: to move somewhere very quickly and often carelessly
senses.exampleEnglish: The children began to tear across the field when they realised the team bus was about to leave without them.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们意识到球队大巴就要不等他们开走时，开始飞奔穿过球场。

senses.english: typical of a larger group
senses.exampleEnglish: The survey used a representative sample of residents so that its results would reflect the wider community's views.
senses.exampleChinese: 调查选用了有代表性的居民样本，以使结果反映更广泛社区的观点。

senses.english: a person chosen to speak or act for others
senses.exampleEnglish: The student representative collected suggestions from each class before presenting them to the school committee at its monthly meeting.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生代表收集各班的建议，再在学校委员会的月会上提出。

senses.english: ability to hold, involve or contain people or things
senses.exampleEnglish: The theatre reached its full capacity before the performance began, so late arrivals had to wait for another show.
senses.exampleChinese: 演出开始前剧院就已满座，因此晚到的人只能等另一场演出。

senses.english: the ability to do or understand something
senses.exampleEnglish: Her capacity to stay calm during a difficult discussion helped the group focus on solutions rather than blaming one another.
senses.exampleChinese: 她在困难讨论中保持冷静的能力，帮助小组专注解决问题，而非互相指责。

senses.english: a particular role in which someone acts
senses.exampleEnglish: She attended the meeting in her capacity as club secretary, rather than as a parent of one of the players.
senses.exampleChinese: 她以俱乐部秘书的身份出席会议，而不是以某位球员家长的身份出席。

senses.english: line separating one country or state from another
senses.exampleEnglish: We crossed the border early in the morning, when there were fewer vehicles waiting at the checkpoint.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们清晨越过边境，当时在检查站等候的车辆较少。

senses.english: an edge around an object or area
senses.exampleEnglish: We added a narrow blue border to the poster so that the central photograph would stand out more clearly.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们给海报加了一条窄蓝边，让中间的照片更加突出。

senses.english: a narrow area of garden planted with flowers or other plants
senses.exampleEnglish: The gardener filled the border with plants that flowered at different times, keeping colour in the garden throughout summer.
senses.exampleChinese: 园丁在花坛种了花期不同的植物，让花园整个夏天都有色彩。

senses.english: to have an edge next to something
senses.exampleEnglish: The fields that border the river are often wet in winter, so the farmer uses them mainly during summer.
senses.exampleChinese: 与河流相邻的田地冬天常常潮湿，所以农民主要在夏季使用。

senses.english: to move something violently back and forth or up and down
senses.exampleEnglish: Please shake the bottle gently before you pour the drink, as some of the fruit has settled at the bottom.
senses.exampleChinese: 倒饮料前请轻轻摇晃瓶子，因为有些果肉沉到了底部。

senses.english: to make repeated small movements because of cold, fear, or emotion
senses.exampleEnglish: His hands began to shake while he waited to speak, although he had practised the presentation several times at home.
senses.exampleChinese: 等候发言时他的手开始发抖，尽管已在家练习过几次演示。

senses.english: to damage someone's confidence or make them feel upset
senses.exampleEnglish: The unexpected result did not shake her confidence, because she knew that a single test could not measure every skill.
senses.exampleChinese: 意外的结果没有动摇她的信心，因为她知道一次测试无法衡量所有技能。

senses.english: a short quick movement from side to side or up and down
senses.exampleEnglish: Give the bottle a gentle shake before pouring the juice, as some of the fruit has settled at the bottom.
senses.exampleChinese: 倒果汁前轻轻摇一下瓶子，因为一些果肉沉到了瓶底。

senses.english: a thick drink made with milk and fruit or other flavouring
senses.exampleEnglish: They shared a strawberry shake at the cafe after their walk, while discussing which route they would try next weekend.
senses.exampleChinese: 散步后，他们在咖啡馆分喝一杯草莓奶昔，讨论下周末尝试哪条路线。

senses.english: opinion based on judging the qualities of something or someone
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher's assessment included practical tasks, which allowed students to show skills that a written test might miss.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师的评价包括实践任务，让学生展示书面测试可能无法反映的技能。

senses.english: outer covering worn on the foot to protect it usually sold in pairs
senses.exampleEnglish: A small stone inside his shoe made walking uncomfortable until he stopped beside the path to remove it.
senses.exampleChinese: 他鞋里的一颗小石子让他走路很不舒服，直到他停在路旁把石子取出来。

senses.english: what is expected; should
senses.exampleEnglish: We ought to check the opening hours before travelling, since the museum sometimes closes earlier during the winter.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们应该在出发前查看开放时间，因为博物馆在冬季有时会提早关门。

senses.english: used to say that something is expected or likely
senses.exampleEnglish: The parcel ought to arrive tomorrow if the delivery follows its normal schedule, although the weather may cause delays.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果配送按平常时间进行，包裹应该明天到，不过天气可能导致延误。

senses.english: public notice or advertisement
senses.exampleEnglish: The job ad mentioned flexible hours, which interested people who needed to balance work with caring for children.
senses.exampleChinese: 招聘广告提到了灵活工时，这吸引了需要兼顾工作和照顾孩子的人。

senses.english: amount of money paid for a particular service
senses.exampleEnglish: There is a small entry fee, but the money helps the museum maintain its collection and run school visits.
senses.exampleChinese: 虽然需要支付少量入场费，但这笔钱帮助博物馆维护藏品，并组织学校参观。

senses.english: a usually long, narrow room in a building  that leads to other rooms
senses.exampleEnglish: We left our wet coats in the hall before entering the living room, where the rest of the family was waiting.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们先把湿外套留在门厅，再走进家里其他人正在等候的客厅。

senses.english: a large room or building used for meetings, entertainment, or public events
senses.exampleEnglish: The village hall was large enough for the whole group, so the organisers moved the indoor activities there when it rained.
senses.exampleChinese: 村会堂足够容纳整个团队，因此下雨时组织者把室内活动移到了那里。

senses.english: official rule that controls how something is done
senses.exampleEnglish: The new safety regulation requires every visitor to wear a helmet before entering the area where construction is taking place.
senses.exampleChinese: 新的安全规定要求每位访客在进入施工区域前都戴上头盔。

senses.english: the process of controlling an activity or system
senses.exampleEnglish: Better regulation of traffic near the school could make the road safer without completely closing it to local drivers.
senses.exampleChinese: 更好地管理学校附近交通，可以提高道路安全，而不必完全禁止本地司机通行。

senses.english: to get away from a place where you are being held
senses.exampleEnglish: The family managed to escape through a back door before smoke made the main hallway impossible to use.
senses.exampleChinese: 在浓烟使主走廊无法通行之前，这一家人设法从后门逃了出去。

senses.english: to avoid something harmful or unpleasant
senses.exampleEnglish: The old building managed to escape serious damage, although several nearby roofs needed repairs after the storm had passed.
senses.exampleChinese: 老建筑幸运地避开严重损坏，不过风暴后，附近几个屋顶需要维修。

senses.english: to be forgotten or not noticed by someone
senses.exampleEnglish: Her name escaped me during the introduction, even though I could remember exactly where we had met before.
senses.exampleChinese: 介绍时我一时想不起她的名字，尽管清楚记得我们以前在哪里见过。

senses.english: an act of getting away from danger or an unpleasant situation
senses.exampleEnglish: Their escape from the crowded city gave them time to rest and think about what they wanted to change.
senses.exampleChinese: 离开拥挤城市的短暂解脱，让他们有时间休息并思考想改变什么。

senses.english: an accidental release of gas or liquid
senses.exampleEnglish: Staff reported an escape of water from a damaged pipe, so the room was closed while repairs were arranged.
senses.exampleChinese: 员工报告一根损坏的管道漏水，因此房间被关闭以安排维修。

senses.english: the building or room where art is made, such as paintings, movies, or music
senses.exampleEnglish: The artist opened her studio to visitors so that they could see how a painting developed from the first sketch.
senses.exampleChinese: 这位画家向访客开放了工作室，让他们了解一幅画如何从最初的草图逐步完成。

senses.english: a small flat with one main room for living and sleeping
senses.exampleEnglish: She rented a studio near the station, accepting the limited space in exchange for a much shorter journey to work.
senses.exampleChinese: 她在车站附近租了单间公寓，以有限空间换取短得多的通勤时间。

senses.english: correct according to social or moral rules
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher explained the proper way to handle the equipment before allowing us to begin the experiment ourselves.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师先解释了正确操作设备的方法，才允许我们自己开始实验。

senses.english: real, complete, or of a satisfactory standard
senses.exampleEnglish: After living on snacks during the journey, they wanted a proper meal with vegetables and somewhere comfortable to sit.
senses.exampleChinese: 旅途中一直靠零食充饥后，他们想吃顿有蔬菜的像样饭菜，并找个舒适的地方坐。

senses.english: to stop feeling nervous or worried; to rest and do something enjoyable
senses.exampleEnglish: After several demanding weeks, they went to the coast to relax without checking messages or following a strict schedule.
senses.exampleChinese: 忙碌了好几周后，他们去海边放松，不再查看消息，也不再遵循严格的时间表。

senses.english: to make rules or conditions less strict
senses.exampleEnglish: The library decided to relax its borrowing rules during the holidays so that students could keep their books for longer.
senses.exampleChinese: 图书馆决定在假期放宽借阅规定，让学生能把书多保留一段时间。

senses.english: someone who travels to a place for pleasure
senses.exampleEnglish: The tourist asked a local shopkeeper for directions because the old streets were not clearly marked on her map.
senses.exampleChinese: 那位游客向当地店主问路，因为她的地图上没有清楚标出那些老街。

senses.english: one of the parts that make up something
senses.exampleEnglish: The engineer replaced one damaged component rather than throwing away the whole machine, which was still in good condition.
senses.exampleChinese: 工程师只更换了一个损坏的零件，而没有扔掉整台仍然状况良好的机器。

senses.english: to have enough money to pay for something
senses.exampleEnglish: We cannot afford to replace the car this year, so we are saving money for essential repairs instead.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们今年买不起新车来换掉旧车，所以正在存钱进行必要的维修。

senses.english: to be able to do something without serious harm or loss
senses.exampleEnglish: We cannot afford to lose another week, because the equipment must be ready before the first visitors arrive.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们承受不起再耽搁一周，因为设备必须在首批访客抵达前准备好。

senses.english: to provide someone with an opportunity or advantage
senses.exampleEnglish: The open windows afford a clear view of the garden, allowing visitors to enjoy the flowers without leaving their seats.
senses.exampleChinese: 敞开的窗户让花园景色一览无余，访客不离开座位也能欣赏鲜花。

senses.english: a professional who is paid to help people with the law
senses.exampleEnglish: The lawyer explained the agreement in plain language so that both sides understood their responsibilities before signing it.
senses.exampleChinese: 律师用通俗的语言解释了协议，让双方在签字前都理解自己的责任。

senses.english: to think that someone may have committed a crime or done something wrong
senses.exampleEnglish: The police suspect that someone entered through the kitchen window, although they have not yet found clear evidence.
senses.exampleChinese: 警方怀疑有人从厨房窗户进入，不过他们还没有找到明确的证据。

senses.english: to think something is probably true without being certain
senses.exampleEnglish: I suspect the shop has already closed, because the lights are off and no one is answering the telephone.
senses.exampleChinese: 我猜商店已经关门，因为灯都关了，也没有人接电话。

senses.english: a person thought possibly responsible for a crime
senses.exampleEnglish: The police interviewed a suspect after comparing the witness's description with information collected from people who worked nearby.
senses.exampleChinese: 警方将证人的描述与附近工作人员提供的信息比对后，询问了一名嫌疑人。

senses.english: not trustworthy or possibly wrong
senses.exampleEnglish: The figures looked suspect because they suggested that every visitor had arrived at exactly the same time.
senses.exampleChinese: 这些数据看起来可疑，因为它们表明每位访客都在完全相同的时刻到达。

senses.english: small round container used to hold liquids for drinking
senses.exampleEnglish: She poured herself a cup of tea while waiting for the rain to stop before walking home.
senses.exampleChinese: 她给自己倒了一杯茶，等雨停后再步行回家。

senses.english: a cup-shaped prize given to the winner of a competition
senses.exampleEnglish: The team displayed its cup in the school entrance, where younger players could see the result of months of practice.
senses.exampleChinese: 球队把奖杯放在学校入口，让年轻球员看到数月训练的成果。

senses.english: a unit for measuring food or liquid in cooking
senses.exampleEnglish: Add one cup of flour gradually while stirring, so that the mixture stays smooth rather than forming dry lumps.
senses.exampleChinese: 一边搅拌一边逐渐加入一杯面粉，让混合物保持顺滑而不结成干块。

senses.english: to form your hands into a curved shape around something
senses.exampleEnglish: She tried to cup the tiny bird gently in her hands while the rescue worker prepared a suitable box.
senses.exampleChinese: 救助人员准备合适的盒子时，她试着双手轻轻捧住小鸟。

senses.english: something that tells you what something is like or looks like
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide's detailed description helped us recognise the building immediately, even though we had never visited the town before.
senses.exampleChinese: 虽然我们从未到过这座城镇，但导游的详细描述帮助我们立刻认出了那栋建筑。

senses.english: feeling that you can do well at something
senses.exampleEnglish: Her confidence grew after she successfully explained her project to a group of people she had never met.
senses.exampleChinese: 她成功地向一群从未见过的人介绍自己的项目后，信心增强了。

senses.english: trust in someone's ability, honesty, or reliability
senses.exampleEnglish: The residents had confidence in the organiser because she had explained the costs honestly and answered their questions clearly.
senses.exampleChinese: 居民信任组织者，因为她坦诚说明了费用，并清楚回答了问题。

senses.english: concerning the people and businesses that make certain products
senses.exampleEnglish: The former industrial area now contains workshops and cafes, although several old factory buildings have been carefully preserved.
senses.exampleChinese: 昔日的工业区如今有了工作坊和咖啡馆，不过几栋老厂房被仔细保留了下来。

senses.english: to say that you are not happy or satisfied with something or someone
senses.exampleEnglish: Customers began to complain when the website continued to accept orders for products that were no longer available.
senses.exampleChinese: 网站仍然接受已经缺货的商品订单时，顾客开始抱怨。

senses.english: way of thinking, an attitude toward something
senses.exampleEnglish: Working with people from different backgrounds gave her a broader perspective on problems she had once considered simple.
senses.exampleChinese: 与来自不同背景的人合作，让她对曾认为简单的问题有了更全面的看法。

senses.english: a way of showing distance and depth in a picture
senses.exampleEnglish: The drawing teacher explained perspective by asking us to compare how wide the road looked nearby and in the distance.
senses.exampleChinese: 绘画老师让我们比较道路近处和远处看起来的宽度，以此讲解透视法。

senses.english: something that is not correct; a mistake
senses.exampleEnglish: We found an error in the timetable, which explained why several visitors had arrived an hour too early.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们发现时刻表里有一处错误，这解释了为什么几位访客提前一个小时到了。

senses.english: to use the law to catch and keep people who committed crimes
senses.exampleEnglish: Police decided not to arrest the man until they had checked whether the witness could identify him reliably.
senses.exampleChinese: 警方决定先核实证人能否可靠地认出那名男子，再决定是否逮捕他。

senses.english: the act of taking someone into police custody
senses.exampleEnglish: The arrest took place after several witnesses provided information that helped the police identify the person responsible.
senses.exampleChinese: 几位证人提供信息，帮助警方确认责任人后，警方实施了逮捕。

senses.english: to judge something's value or suitability
senses.exampleEnglish: Before we choose a new supplier, we need to assess whether it can deliver materials reliably throughout the year.
senses.exampleChinese: 选择新供应商之前，我们需要评估它能否全年稳定地供应材料。

senses.english: to record your name on an official list; sign up
senses.exampleEnglish: You must register for the workshop in advance because the room can only hold a limited number of participants.
senses.exampleChinese: 你必须提前报名参加工作坊，因为房间只能容纳有限数量的参与者。

senses.english: an official list or record of names or details
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher checked the register before leaving, so that no student would accidentally be left behind at the museum.
senses.exampleChinese: 离开前老师核对了名册，避免不小心把学生留在博物馆。

senses.english: to show or record a measurement
senses.exampleEnglish: The machine did not register any change in temperature until we moved its sensor away from the open window.
senses.exampleChinese: 直到把传感器移离敞开的窗户，机器才记录到温度变化。

senses.english: to notice or understand something
senses.exampleEnglish: Her warning did not register immediately, because I was concentrating on finding the correct platform for our train.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的提醒没有让我马上反应过来，因为我正专注寻找正确的火车站台。

senses.english: a style of language suitable for a particular situation
senses.exampleEnglish: The letter used a formal register, although its message was simply to thank volunteers for helping with the event.
senses.exampleChinese: 这封信用了正式语体，但内容只是感谢志愿者协助活动。

senses.english: a person or thing that has value or use to someone or to a company
senses.exampleEnglish: Her ability to remain calm under pressure became a valuable asset when the team faced an unexpected problem.
senses.exampleChinese: 当团队遇到意外问题时，她在压力下保持冷静的能力成了宝贵的优势。

senses.english: An action, change, or process that gives information about something
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide raised her hand as a signal that the group should stop talking and listen to the announcement.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游举起手，示意大家停止交谈，听广播通知。

senses.english: to communicate by a movement, sound, or other sign
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide will signal when it is safe to cross, so please wait beside the path until she raises her hand.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游会示意何时可以安全通过，请在路旁等到她举手。

senses.english: to show that something exists or is likely to happen
senses.exampleEnglish: The new timetable may signal a change in the company's priorities, with more services aimed at people travelling for work.
senses.exampleChinese: 新时刻表可能标志着公司重点的变化，增加了面向通勤者的班次。

senses.english: one of the five long parts of the hand
senses.exampleEnglish: She ran a finger along the map to show the route we would follow after leaving the village.
senses.exampleChinese: 她用一根手指沿着地图移动，指示我们离开村庄后要走的路线。

senses.english: to touch or handle something with your fingers
senses.exampleEnglish: She continued to finger the old photograph while describing how the street had changed since her family first moved there.
senses.exampleChinese: 她抚摸着旧照片，描述自家最初搬来以后街道的变化。

senses.english: direct related to a subject in a considerable way
senses.exampleEnglish: Please include only relevant information in your application so that the reader can quickly understand why you suit the role.
senses.exampleChinese: 请在申请中只填写相关信息，让阅读者迅速理解你为什么适合这个岗位。

senses.english: to learn about something by examining in detail or someplace by traveling to it
senses.exampleEnglish: During the afternoon, we had enough time to explore the old harbour and learn why it had once been important.
senses.exampleChinese: 下午我们有足够的时间探索老港口，了解它为什么曾经十分重要。

senses.english: to examine an idea or possibility in detail
senses.exampleEnglish: The workshop will explore different ways of reducing waste before asking each group to design a practical local project.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作坊将探讨减少浪费的不同方法，再让各组设计可行的本地项目。

senses.english: quality of being able to guide or influence others
senses.exampleEnglish: Under her leadership, the team began sharing ideas more openly instead of waiting for someone else to make every decision.
senses.exampleChinese: 在她的领导下，团队开始更坦诚地分享想法，而不是等着别人作出每一个决定。

senses.english: a promise or decision to do something; something that you must do that takes your time
senses.exampleEnglish: Joining the evening course requires a commitment to regular study, especially when you already have a busy working week.
senses.exampleChinese: 参加晚间课程需要承诺坚持学习，尤其是在你一周工作本来就很忙的情况下。

senses.english: something you must do that takes your time or resources
senses.exampleEnglish: Family commitments make it difficult for her to attend evening meetings, so the club now offers a morning option.
senses.exampleChinese: 家庭责任让她难以参加晚间会议，因此俱乐部现在提供上午的选择。

senses.english: a strong willingness to give time and effort to something
senses.exampleEnglish: Her commitment to education was clear from the extra time she spent helping students who had fallen behind.
senses.exampleChinese: 她额外花时间帮助落后的学生，清楚体现了对教育的投入。

senses.english: to stop sleeping; to make someone stop sleeping
senses.exampleEnglish: I usually wake before the alarm rings, but after the long journey I slept until almost ten.
senses.exampleChinese: 我通常在闹钟响之前就醒来，但长途旅行后，我一直睡到将近十点。

senses.english: the moving water left behind a travelling boat
senses.exampleEnglish: The ducks moved away from the boat's wake, then returned to the quieter water close to the riverbank.
senses.exampleChinese: 鸭子避开船尾的波浪，随后回到河岸附近较平静的水面。

senses.english: a gathering held before or after a funeral
senses.exampleEnglish: At the wake, friends shared memories that helped the family remember the happy parts of a long life.
senses.exampleChinese: 在葬礼聚会上，朋友们分享往事，帮助家人回忆漫长人生中的快乐片段。

senses.english: in a way that is needed or required, or is unavoidable
senses.exampleEnglish: A more expensive product is not necessarily better, particularly if it includes features that you will never use.
senses.exampleChinese: 更贵的产品不一定更好，尤其是它包含一些你永远用不到的功能时。

senses.english: producing a lot of light
senses.exampleEnglish: The kitchen was bright even on cloudy days because its large windows faced the open garden behind the house.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使阴天，厨房里也很明亮，因为大窗户正对着房子后面的开阔花园。

senses.english: quick to learn and understand things
senses.exampleEnglish: The bright student often found unusual solutions, but she still needed practice explaining her ideas clearly to others.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个聪明的学生常找到不同寻常的办法，但仍需练习向别人清楚解释想法。

senses.english: strong and easily noticed in colour
senses.exampleEnglish: They painted the door bright blue so that visitors could recognise the entrance even on dark winter afternoons.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们把门漆成鲜蓝色，让访客在昏暗的冬日下午也能认出入口。

senses.english: likely to bring success or happiness
senses.exampleEnglish: The young team's future looked bright after several experienced volunteers offered to help with training and equipment.
senses.exampleChinese: 几位有经验的志愿者主动协助训练和设备后，这支年轻球队的未来显得光明。

senses.english: showing happiness and energy
senses.exampleEnglish: Her bright smile helped the nervous newcomers feel welcome before they had even entered the crowded meeting room.
senses.exampleChinese: 她欢快的笑容让紧张的新来者还未走进拥挤会议室就感到受欢迎。

senses.english: a structure that supports or surrounds something
senses.exampleEnglish: The wooden frame was still strong, so we repaired the seat instead of buying a completely new chair.
senses.exampleChinese: 木框架仍很结实，所以我们修好了椅面，而没有买一把全新的椅子。

senses.english: one picture in the series that forms a film or video
senses.exampleEnglish: The editor examined each frame carefully to find the moment when the bird first entered the camera's view.
senses.exampleChinese: 编辑仔细检查每一帧，寻找鸟第一次进入镜头的时刻。

senses.english: to put a picture or object inside a frame
senses.exampleEnglish: We decided to frame the old photograph so that it could be displayed safely rather than left in a drawer.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们决定给老照片装框，让它能安全展示，而不是放在抽屉里。

senses.english: to make an innocent person appear responsible for a crime
senses.exampleEnglish: In the story, someone tries to frame the journalist because her investigation could reveal how the money disappeared.
senses.exampleChinese: 故事中，有人试图诬陷记者，因为她的调查可能揭露钱款消失的原因。

senses.english: to express a question or idea in a particular way
senses.exampleEnglish: Try to frame the question neutrally so that people feel free to give an answer you may not expect.
senses.exampleChinese: 试着中立地组织问题，让人们能自由给出你未必预料到的回答。

senses.english: done in a way that takes a long time
senses.exampleEnglish: We walked slowly through the gallery so that we had time to notice details in the paintings and discuss them.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们慢慢走过画廊，这样就有时间注意画中的细节，并进行讨论。

senses.english: a connection between people or groups
senses.exampleEnglish: The bond between the neighbours grew stronger after they worked together to repair the damage caused by the storm.
senses.exampleChinese: 邻居们一起修复风暴造成的损坏后，彼此之间的联系更加紧密了。

senses.english: a document representing money lent to a government or company
senses.exampleEnglish: The article explained how a government bond differs from a company share, using a simple example rather than complex figures.
senses.exampleChinese: 文章用简单例子而非复杂数字，解释政府债券与公司股票的区别。

senses.english: a strong physical connection between materials
senses.exampleEnglish: The glue forms a strong bond once it has dried, so we left the repaired chair untouched overnight.
senses.exampleChinese: 胶水干后会形成牢固黏合，因此我们把修好的椅子放了一夜没动。

senses.english: to develop a close relationship
senses.exampleEnglish: Working on the same project helped the new members bond, especially when they solved a difficult problem together.
senses.exampleChinese: 共同项目帮助新成员建立联系，尤其是他们一起解决难题的时候。

senses.english: to join materials firmly together
senses.exampleEnglish: The technician will bond the two surfaces after cleaning them thoroughly, because dust could weaken the final connection.
senses.exampleChinese: 技术员会彻底清洁两个表面再黏合，因为灰尘可能削弱最终连接。

senses.english: to employ a person to do a particular job
senses.exampleEnglish: The company plans to hire two experienced designers who can help improve products without making them more expensive.
senses.exampleChinese: 公司计划聘用两位经验丰富的设计师，帮助改进产品，同时不提高售价。

senses.english: to pay to use something for a limited time
senses.exampleEnglish: We plan to hire bicycles near the station, allowing us to explore the villages without needing a car.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们计划在车站附近租自行车，不用汽车也能游览村庄。

senses.english: the act of paying to use something temporarily
senses.exampleEnglish: The price includes bicycle hire for the whole afternoon, although visitors must return the equipment before the centre closes.
senses.exampleChinese: 费用包括整个下午的自行车租用，但访客必须在中心关门前归还设备。

senses.english: a person recently employed by an organisation
senses.exampleEnglish: The new hire spent her first week observing different departments before taking responsibility for her own group of customers.
senses.exampleChinese: 新员工第一周观察了不同部门，之后开始负责自己的客户群。

senses.english: hollow place; opening into or through something
senses.exampleEnglish: We noticed a small hole in the tent just before the rain started, so we covered it immediately.
senses.exampleChinese: 下雨前，我们发现帐篷上有一个小洞，于是立刻把它盖住了。

senses.english: a weakness or missing part in an argument or plan
senses.exampleEnglish: The reviewer found a hole in our argument because we had not considered how the costs might change next year.
senses.exampleChinese: 评审发现我们的论证有漏洞，因为我们没考虑明年成本可能如何变化。

senses.english: a golf target and the section of course leading to it
senses.exampleEnglish: The final hole was difficult because the wind pushed the ball towards the trees on one side of the course.
senses.exampleChinese: 最后一洞很难，因为风把球吹向球道一侧的树木。

senses.english: to join together two ends of string or rope; to join two or more things together with string or rope
senses.exampleEnglish: You should tie the bags securely before putting them in the car, otherwise their contents may fall out.
senses.exampleChinese: 把袋子放进车里之前应该扎紧，否则里面的东西可能会掉出来。

senses.english: a long narrow piece of cloth worn around the neck
senses.exampleEnglish: He chose a plain tie for the interview because he wanted his clothes to look professional without attracting attention.
senses.exampleChinese: 他为面试选了素色领带，希望衣着专业但不惹眼。

senses.english: a result in which competitors have the same score
senses.exampleEnglish: The game ended in a tie, so both teams left the field pleased with how strongly they had played.
senses.exampleChinese: 比赛以平局结束，两队离场时都对自己的出色表现感到满意。

senses.english: to finish with the same score as another competitor
senses.exampleEnglish: They managed to tie the match in the final minute, giving supporters a result that had seemed unlikely earlier.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们在最后一分钟追成平局，让支持者看到了先前似乎不可能的结果。

senses.english: a connection between people, groups, or places
senses.exampleEnglish: She kept strong ties with her old neighbourhood by visiting regularly and helping organise the annual summer celebration.
senses.exampleChinese: 她定期回访并协助组织年度夏日庆典，与旧社区保持紧密联系。

senses.english: to connect things so that one depends on another
senses.exampleEnglish: The agreement will tie future payments to the amount of work completed, rather than to a fixed monthly schedule.
senses.exampleChinese: 协议将把未来付款与完成的工作量挂钩，而不是采用固定月度安排。

senses.english: within or inside
senses.exampleEnglish: An internal review showed that several departments were collecting the same information without sharing it with one another.
senses.exampleChinese: 一次内部审查发现，几个部门都在收集同样的信息，却没有互相分享。

senses.english: series of connected  things, events, or people
senses.exampleEnglish: The delayed delivery started a chain of problems that affected every workshop waiting for the same materials.
senses.exampleChinese: 交货延误引发了一连串问题，影响了所有等待同样材料的车间。

senses.english: a series of connected metal rings
senses.exampleEnglish: A heavy chain secured the gate while the owner repaired the old lock that had stopped working properly.
senses.exampleChinese: 旧锁失灵后，主人维修期间用一条粗链条锁住了大门。

senses.english: a group of shops or other businesses under the same ownership
senses.exampleEnglish: The hotel belongs to a small chain, but its manager chooses local food and decorations that reflect the town's history.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家酒店属于小型连锁机构，但经理选择反映当地历史的本地食物和装饰。

senses.english: to fasten something using a chain
senses.exampleEnglish: Please chain the bicycle to the rack before entering the station, rather than leaving it beside the busy doorway.
senses.exampleChinese: 进站前请用链条把自行车锁在车架上，不要留在繁忙的门口。

senses.english: writings that are valued as works of art, esp. fiction, drama and poetry
senses.exampleEnglish: Reading literature from different countries helped her understand how people described family life in different periods of history.
senses.exampleChinese: 阅读不同国家的文学作品，帮助她了解人们如何描述不同历史时期的家庭生活。

senses.english: written information or research about a subject
senses.exampleEnglish: The nurse gave us some literature about the service, including details that we could read carefully after returning home.
senses.exampleChinese: 护士给了我们一些服务资料，包括可以回家后仔细阅读的详情。

senses.english: person who has suffered from a crime, bad situation, or event
senses.exampleEnglish: The charity offered temporary accommodation to every victim of the flood who could not safely return home.
senses.exampleChinese: 慈善机构为每一位无法安全返家的洪灾受害者提供了临时住所。

senses.english: to say you will harm or hurt someone
senses.exampleEnglish: The landlord must not threaten tenants who ask for essential repairs, even if he disagrees with their complaints.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使房东不同意租客的投诉，也不能威胁那些要求进行必要维修的租客。

senses.english: to put something in danger or make a bad event likely
senses.exampleEnglish: The approaching storm could threaten the outdoor festival, so the organisers prepared an indoor plan before selling more tickets.
senses.exampleChinese: 逼近的风暴可能危及户外节日，因此组织者在继续售票前准备了室内方案。

senses.english: act of separating something into parts; groups formed by different functions or opinions
senses.exampleEnglish: The division of tasks was clear, so each volunteer knew what to do when the first visitors arrived.
senses.exampleChinese: 任务分工很明确，因此第一批访客到达时，每位志愿者都知道该做什么。

senses.english: a separate part of a large organisation
senses.exampleEnglish: The marketing division asked the designers for clearer photographs before preparing the information that would appear in the new catalogue.
senses.exampleChinese: 营销部门在编写新目录的信息前，向设计师索要了更清晰的照片。

senses.english: a serious difference of opinion between people
senses.exampleEnglish: The proposal caused division among residents, with some welcoming more visitors and others worrying about noise and traffic.
senses.exampleChinese: 提案引发居民分歧，有人欢迎更多游客，有人担心噪音和交通。

senses.english: the mathematical process of finding how many times one number fits into another
senses.exampleEnglish: The children used counters to practise division, sharing them equally between groups before writing down the number in each group.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们用计数片练习除法，先平均分组，再写下每组数量。

senses.english: to protect something from danger or harm, keep things safe
senses.exampleEnglish: We used a strong cover to secure the equipment against rain while it was being transported to the island.
senses.exampleChinese: 设备被运往岛上的过程中，我们用结实的罩子保护它免受雨淋。

senses.english: to obtain something with effort
senses.exampleEnglish: The club hopes to secure enough funding to repair the roof before winter makes the building difficult to use.
senses.exampleChinese: 俱乐部希望争取到足够资金，在冬季使建筑难以使用前修好屋顶。

senses.english: to fasten something firmly so that it cannot move
senses.exampleEnglish: We used straps to secure the boxes inside the van, preventing them from moving when the driver turned corners.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们用绑带固定货车里的箱子，避免司机转弯时箱子移动。

senses.english: protected from danger or loss
senses.exampleEnglish: The records are stored in a secure cabinet so that only authorised staff can read the personal information inside.
senses.exampleChinese: 档案存放在安全柜中，只有获授权的员工能读取其中的个人信息。

senses.english: firmly fastened and unlikely to move
senses.exampleEnglish: Check that the ladder is secure before climbing, especially if the ground underneath it is wet or uneven.
senses.exampleChinese: 爬梯子前要确认梯子牢固，尤其是下面地面潮湿或不平时。

senses.english: confident and not worried about your situation
senses.exampleEnglish: Children feel more secure when they understand the routine and know which adult they can ask for help.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们了解日常安排并知道能向哪位大人求助时，会更有安全感。

senses.english: to cause wonder; to surprise completely
senses.exampleEnglish: It continues to amaze me how much useful information we can find by asking careful questions and listening patiently.
senses.exampleChinese: 通过认真提问和耐心倾听能够获取如此多的有用信息，这一点始终让我惊讶。

senses.english: object, machine, or equipment for a specific use
senses.exampleEnglish: The small device measures how much electricity each appliance uses, helping families identify where they can reduce waste.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个小装置测量每件电器的用电量，帮助家庭发现哪里可以减少浪费。

senses.english: a method used to produce a particular effect
senses.exampleEnglish: The writer uses humour as a device to introduce serious questions without making younger readers feel that they are being lectured.
senses.exampleChinese: 作者用幽默这种手法引出严肃问题，又不让年轻读者觉得在受说教。

senses.english: when a baby comes out of the body of its mother
senses.exampleEnglish: After the birth of their daughter, they moved closer to family so that relatives could visit more easily.
senses.exampleChinese: 女儿出生后，他们搬到了离家人更近的地方，以便亲戚更方便地来访。

senses.english: the beginning of something new
senses.exampleEnglish: The opening of the workshop marked the birth of a local business that later employed people from several nearby villages.
senses.exampleChinese: 工作坊开业标志着一家本地企业诞生，后来它雇用了附近几个村庄的人。

senses.english: large area with many trees
senses.exampleEnglish: We followed a marked path through the forest because leaving it could disturb wildlife and make finding our way difficult.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们沿着标记好的小路穿过森林，因为离开小路可能打扰野生动物，也容易迷路。

senses.english: a piece of paper or cloth that is attached to something and gives information about it
senses.exampleEnglish: Before washing the jacket, check the label inside to find out which temperature and washing method are recommended.
senses.exampleChinese: 洗这件夹克之前，先查看里面的标签，了解建议的水温和洗涤方法。

senses.english: to attach identifying information to something
senses.exampleEnglish: Please label each box clearly before moving it, so that volunteers can take the contents directly to the correct room.
senses.exampleChinese: 搬动前请清楚标记每个箱子，让志愿者能直接把物品送进正确房间。

senses.english: to describe someone or something in a particular way
senses.exampleEnglish: It is unfair to label a student lazy before finding out whether the task has been explained clearly enough.
senses.exampleChinese: 还没弄清任务是否解释到位就把学生说成懒惰，是不公平的。

senses.english: part of a plant that grows underground
senses.exampleEnglish: The tree's damaged root could no longer support it properly, so experts advised removing it before the next storm.
senses.exampleChinese: 树木受损的根已无法稳固地支撑它，因此专家建议在下一场风暴前移除这棵树。

senses.english: the basic cause or origin of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The discussion helped us identify the root of the problem, rather than simply repairing the most visible damage.
senses.exampleChinese: 讨论帮助我们找到了问题根源，而不只是修补最明显的损坏。

senses.english: a number that produces another number when multiplied by itself a specified number of times
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher showed how to find a square root by comparing familiar numbers before introducing a calculator.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师先比较熟悉的数字来展示求平方根的方法，再引入计算器。

senses.english: building where things are made
senses.exampleEnglish: The factory introduced quieter machines after nearby residents complained that production continued long after they had gone to bed.
senses.exampleChinese: 附近居民抱怨他们上床很久后工厂仍在生产，于是工厂引进了更安静的机器。

senses.english: the amount of money that is needed to pay for something
senses.exampleEnglish: We shared the expense of hiring a car because travelling together was cheaper than buying separate train tickets.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们分担了租车费用，因为一起出行比各自购买火车票更便宜。

senses.english: a passage of water that boats can travel along
senses.exampleEnglish: The narrow channel between the two islands became difficult to cross when strong winds pushed waves against the boats.
senses.exampleChinese: 大风把海浪推向船只，使两座岛之间狭窄的水道变得难以穿越。

senses.english: a television station or the programmes it broadcasts
senses.exampleEnglish: The science channel showed a documentary about rivers, which gave the students ideas for their own research project.
senses.exampleChinese: 科学频道播放了一部河流纪录片，给学生自己的研究项目带来了想法。

senses.english: a way of sending information, money, or other things
senses.exampleEnglish: The school created a new channel for parents to share concerns without waiting for the next formal meeting.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校为家长开辟了表达担忧的新渠道，不必等到下一次正式会议。

senses.english: to direct money, energy, or attention towards a particular purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The charity will channel donations into repairs that allow families to return home safely after the flood.
senses.exampleChinese: 慈善机构会把捐款投入维修，让家庭在洪灾后安全返家。

senses.english: to try to find out facts; to carry out research
senses.exampleEnglish: The school will investigate why the heating failed so that the same problem does not interrupt lessons next winter.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校将调查暖气故障的原因，避免明年冬天再因同样的问题影响上课。

senses.english: suggestion about someone or something being a good choice
senses.exampleEnglish: We booked the restaurant on a friend's recommendation, and its quiet atmosphere made it perfect for our family celebration.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们听从朋友的推荐预订了这家餐厅，其安静的氛围十分适合我们的家庭庆祝活动。

senses.english: to place someone or something in higher or lower position relative to others
senses.exampleEnglish: The judges rank each design according to its usefulness, appearance, and the amount of material needed to produce it.
senses.exampleChinese: 评委根据实用性、外观和生产所需的材料数量，对每个设计进行排名。

senses.english: a position in an ordered list or social system
senses.exampleEnglish: Her rank improved after the final competition, although she was more pleased with the progress in her own performance.
senses.exampleChinese: 最后一场比赛后她的排名上升了，但她更为自身表现的进步高兴。

senses.english: an official level in the armed forces
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide explained how the badges showed each officer's rank, helping visitors understand the uniforms displayed in the museum.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游解释徽章如何显示军官的军衔，帮助访客理解博物馆展出的制服。

senses.english: normal; usual; expected
senses.exampleEnglish: A typical day on the farm begins before sunrise, when the animals need feeding and the fields are still quiet.
senses.exampleChinese: 农场里普通的一天从日出前开始，那时需要喂动物，田野也还很安静。

senses.english: the direction where the sun sets; opposite of east
senses.exampleEnglish: The village lies to the west of the lake, where a narrow road connects it with the nearest town.
senses.exampleChinese: 村庄位于湖的西边，一条狭窄的公路把它与最近的城镇连接起来。

senses.english: in or facing the west
senses.exampleEnglish: The west side of the house becomes warm in the afternoon, so we usually close the curtains before lunch.
senses.exampleChinese: 房子的西侧下午会热起来，所以我们通常午饭前就拉上窗帘。

senses.english: towards the west
senses.exampleEnglish: We travelled west after leaving the town, following a narrow road that eventually reached the quiet coastal village.
senses.exampleChinese: 离开城镇后我们向西行驶，沿着一条窄路最终来到安静的海边村庄。

senses.english: kind and helpful towards other people
senses.exampleEnglish: The staff were friendly and patient, even when visitors asked the same questions repeatedly during the busiest part of the day.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使游客在一天最忙的时候反复提出同样的问题，工作人员仍然友好而耐心。

senses.english: a sports match played for practice rather than a competition prize
senses.exampleEnglish: The teams arranged a friendly before the season began, giving new players a chance to practise working together.
senses.exampleChinese: 赛季开始前，两队安排了一场友谊赛，让新球员有机会练习配合。

senses.english: a person, animal, or plant who lives in a particular place
senses.exampleEnglish: Each resident received a letter explaining when the water would be turned off and how long the repairs would take.
senses.exampleChinese: 每位居民都收到了一封信，说明何时停水以及维修需要多长时间。

senses.english: living or working in a particular place
senses.exampleEnglish: The resident artist offers workshops at the museum, allowing visitors to see how an idea develops into a finished picture.
senses.exampleChinese: 驻馆艺术家在博物馆举办工作坊，让访客看到想法如何发展成成品画作。

senses.english: 1. supplies that are needed or wanted; something that is supplied; 2. part of a law or an agreement
senses.exampleEnglish: The agreement includes a provision that allows either side to request a review if the working conditions change significantly.
senses.exampleChinese: 协议包含一项条款，允许任何一方在工作条件发生重大变化时要求重新审查。

senses.english: the act of supplying something that people need
senses.exampleEnglish: The provision of reliable transport made it easier for older residents to attend appointments without depending entirely on relatives.
senses.exampleChinese: 可靠交通的提供，让老年居民更容易赴约，不必完全依赖亲属。

senses.english: supplies of food and other necessary things, usually in the plural
senses.exampleEnglish: We packed enough provisions for two days because there would be no shops along the more remote part of the route.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们准备了足够两天的给养，因为较偏远的那段路线沿途没有商店。

senses.english: to give all your attention to a task; focus
senses.exampleEnglish: I find it easier to concentrate on difficult tasks when I put my phone away and close unnecessary computer windows.
senses.exampleChinese: 把手机放到一旁并关闭不必要的电脑窗口后，我更容易专注于困难的任务。

senses.english: to make a substance stronger by removing some of its water or other material
senses.exampleEnglish: The factory uses a process to concentrate the juice before transport, reducing the space needed to carry it.
senses.exampleChinese: 工厂在运输前用一道工序浓缩果汁，减少运输所需空间。

senses.english: to collect in one place or cause things to do so
senses.exampleEnglish: Most visitors concentrate near the entrance, although there are quieter paths leading to the gardens behind the main building.
senses.exampleChinese: 多数访客聚在入口附近，尽管也有更安静的小路通向主楼后的花园。

senses.english: a substance made stronger by removing water or other material
senses.exampleEnglish: The label explains how much water to add to the concentrate before serving the drink to the guests.
senses.exampleChinese: 标签说明了给浓缩液加多少水，然后才能把饮料端给客人。

senses.english: a large  amount of something; a lot; not too little
senses.exampleEnglish: There was plenty of time before the train left, so we decided to have breakfast at a nearby cafe.
senses.exampleChinese: 离火车出发还有充足的时间，所以我们决定去附近的咖啡馆吃早餐。

senses.english: more than enough for a purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The bag is plenty big enough for the weekend, especially if we avoid packing clothes that we will never wear.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个包应付周末完全够大，尤其是我们不带那些根本不会穿的衣服时。

senses.english: to send goods to be sold in another country
senses.exampleEnglish: Local farmers export their fruit to neighbouring countries, where it can be sold soon after it has been picked.
senses.exampleChinese: 当地农民把水果出口到邻国，让水果在采摘后不久就能出售。

senses.english: a product sent to another country for sale, or the act of sending it
senses.exampleEnglish: Fruit exports increased after the new railway opened, allowing farmers to deliver fresh produce to the port more quickly.
senses.exampleChinese: 新铁路开通后，水果出口增加，农民能更快把新鲜农产品运到港口。

senses.english: to save computer information in a form that another program can use
senses.exampleEnglish: You can export the finished chart as an image, then include it in a report without rebuilding it.
senses.exampleChinese: 你可以把完成的图表导出为图片，再放入报告，而不必重做。

senses.english: fully or completely
senses.exampleEnglish: The delay was not entirely the driver's fault, because road repairs had made the usual route impossible to follow.
senses.exampleChinese: 延误并不完全是司机的错，因为道路维修使通常的路线无法通行。

senses.english: in a strong manner; in a very serious way
senses.exampleEnglish: She strongly recommended visiting the museum early, before large groups arrived and made the smaller galleries feel crowded.
senses.exampleChinese: 她强烈建议早点去博物馆，以免大批参观团到来后，小展厅变得拥挤。

senses.english: structure built over river or road so people, vehicles, or animals can cross
senses.exampleEnglish: The old bridge was closed to heavy vehicles after engineers discovered damage that required several months of careful repair.
senses.exampleChinese: 工程师发现旧桥的损坏需要数月细致维修后，禁止重型车辆通行。

senses.english: to reduce a difference or make a connection between things
senses.exampleEnglish: The new programme aims to bridge the gap between classroom study and the skills needed in everyday work.
senses.exampleChinese: 新项目旨在弥合课堂学习与日常工作所需技能之间的差距。

senses.english: the upper part of the nose between the eyes
senses.exampleEnglish: The glasses rested comfortably on the bridge of her nose, unlike the old pair that always slipped down.
senses.exampleChinese: 眼镜舒适地架在她的鼻梁上，不像旧眼镜总是往下滑。

senses.english: a card game played by four people in two partnerships
senses.exampleEnglish: They meet every Thursday to play bridge, enjoying the conversation as much as the challenge of the game.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们每周四聚在一起打桥牌，既享受游戏挑战，也喜欢聊天。

senses.english: to have as an essential, necessary or main part
senses.exampleEnglish: The course will consist of weekly discussions and practical projects, rather than relying entirely on lectures and written tests.
