senses.english: something kept for future use
senses.exampleEnglish: The group kept a reserve of drinking water in case the journey took longer than planned or the weather became hotter.
senses.exampleChinese: 团队储备了饮用水，以防路程超时或天气变热。

senses.english: an area where wildlife and natural features are protected
senses.exampleEnglish: The nature reserve has marked paths so that visitors can watch wildlife without damaging the plants around their habitats.
senses.exampleChinese: 自然保护区设有标记步道，让访客观察野生动物时不损害其栖息地附近的植物。

senses.english: a tendency not to show feelings or speak freely
senses.exampleEnglish: Her natural reserve disappeared once she realised that the group was interested in listening rather than judging her ideas.
senses.exampleChinese: 意识到团队愿意倾听而非评判她的想法后，她天生的拘谨消失了。

senses.english: saying something is wrong and should be changed
senses.exampleEnglish: The hotel responded to our complaint by offering a quieter room away from the lift and the main entrance.
senses.exampleChinese: 酒店回应了我们的投诉，为我们安排了一间远离电梯和主入口、更安静的房间。

senses.english: an illness or medical problem
senses.exampleEnglish: The information leaflet described a common complaint in clear language, encouraging readers to discuss personal questions with qualified staff.
senses.exampleChinese: 资料单用清楚语言介绍一种常见病，鼓励读者向合格人员咨询个人问题。

senses.english: to make someone not interested in something
senses.exampleEnglish: The speaker did not bore the audience with unnecessary detail, but used short stories to explain the main ideas.
senses.exampleChinese: 演讲者没有用不必要的细节让观众厌烦，而是用简短故事解释主要观点。

senses.english: to make a hole using a tool
senses.exampleEnglish: The carpenter will bore a small hole before adding the screw, reducing the risk that the dry wood will split.
senses.exampleChinese: 木匠会在加螺丝前钻个小孔，减少干木头裂开的风险。

senses.english: someone or something that is very uninteresting
senses.exampleEnglish: Waiting in the empty office was a bore, but we used the time to plan the rest of our afternoon.
senses.exampleChinese: 在空办公室等候很无聊，但我们利用时间安排了下午余下的活动。

senses.english: a special task or job that is given to a person or group
senses.exampleEnglish: The team's mission was to restore the riverside path so that residents could walk safely between the two villages.
senses.exampleChinese: 团队的任务是修复河边小路，让居民能够在两个村庄之间安全步行。

senses.english: a group sent officially to do work in another place
senses.exampleEnglish: The trade mission visited several factories, hoping to understand local production before discussing possible cooperation with the companies involved.
senses.exampleChinese: 贸易代表团访问几家工厂，希望先了解当地生产，再讨论与相关公司合作的可能。

senses.english: in a way that is not known or certain
senses.exampleEnglish: We somehow managed to fit all the equipment into the car, although there was hardly any room left for our bags.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们不知怎么地把所有设备都塞进了车里，不过几乎没有空间再放包了。

senses.english: sound of a voice that shows emotion or meaning
senses.exampleEnglish: Although her words were polite, the impatient tone of her voice made it clear that she wanted the discussion to end.
senses.exampleChinese: 虽然她的措辞很礼貌，但不耐烦的语气清楚表明她想结束讨论。

senses.english: the general attitude or feeling expressed in writing or an event
senses.exampleEnglish: The tone of the letter was friendly but firm, making clear that the organiser still expected a reply.
senses.exampleChinese: 信的语气友好而坚定，清楚表明组织者仍期待回复。

senses.english: a musical sound with a particular pitch or quality
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher played a single tone and asked the students to match it before singing the full melody together.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师奏出一个音，让学生先跟准，再一起唱完整旋律。

senses.english: a particular shade or quality of colour
senses.exampleEnglish: The painter chose warm tones for the room, hoping they would make the large space feel more comfortable.
senses.exampleChinese: 画家为房间选了暖色调，希望让大空间显得更舒适。

senses.english: the firmness and strength of muscles
senses.exampleEnglish: The instructor explained muscle tone using a simple diagram before showing how the different movements involved the arms and shoulders.
senses.exampleChinese: 教练先用简单图示解释肌肉张力，再展示不同动作如何运用手臂和肩膀。

senses.english: to make muscles firmer and stronger
senses.exampleEnglish: The class includes movements that tone the arms, although the instructor adjusts each activity to suit different levels of experience.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程含锻炼手臂紧实度的动作，但教练会按经验水平调整活动。

senses.english: area of a town or city that people live in
senses.exampleEnglish: The new playground gave families in the neighborhood somewhere safe to meet, especially during the long summer evenings.
senses.exampleChinese: 新游乐场为附近的家庭提供了安全的聚会地点，尤其适合夏季漫长的傍晚。

senses.english: A person who is traveling in a vehicle
senses.exampleEnglish: Each passenger was asked to keep the aisle clear so that staff could move safely through the train.
senses.exampleChinese: 每位乘客都被要求保持过道通畅，让工作人员能够安全地在火车里走动。

senses.english: quality of being fair, equal, or just
senses.exampleEnglish: The story explores whether justice is possible when people judge a stranger before hearing what really happened to him.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个故事探讨了：在人们尚未了解陌生人的真实遭遇就判断他时，正义是否可能实现。

senses.english: a judge, especially in a high court
senses.exampleEnglish: The justice listened to both sides before explaining which part of the law was relevant to the dispute.
senses.exampleChinese: 法官听取双方意见，再解释法律哪部分适用于争议。

senses.english: distinct part or step in a process
senses.exampleEnglish: During the first phase of the project, we collected ideas before deciding which changes would be most useful to residents.
senses.exampleChinese: 在项目的第一阶段，我们先收集想法，再决定哪些改变对居民最有用。

senses.english: to arrange something so that it happens in stages
senses.exampleEnglish: The manager decided to phase the repairs over several weeks, allowing part of the centre to remain open throughout the work.
senses.exampleChinese: 经理决定分几周维修，让中心一部分在整个工程期间保持开放。

senses.english: not thick; not wide in size
senses.exampleEnglish: The book had thin pages that were easily damaged, so the librarian asked us to turn them carefully.
senses.exampleChinese: 这本书的纸页很薄，容易损坏，因此图书管理员请我们小心翻阅。

senses.english: small in number or amount compared with what is usual
senses.exampleEnglish: The crowd was thin during the morning, but more visitors arrived once the rain stopped and the outdoor stalls opened.
senses.exampleChinese: 早上人群稀少，但雨停、室外摊位开放后，更多访客到来了。

senses.english: to make something less thick or less crowded
senses.exampleEnglish: The gardener will thin the young plants so that those remaining have enough space and light to grow well.
senses.exampleChinese: 园丁会给幼苗间苗，让留下的有足够空间和光照生长。

senses.english: to do something very quickly
senses.exampleEnglish: There is no need to rush through the final checks, since a small mistake could cause problems later.
senses.exampleChinese: 最后检查时没有必要匆忙行事，因为一个小错误可能会在以后造成问题。

senses.english: an act of moving or doing something very quickly
senses.exampleEnglish: In the rush to leave, we forgot the map that we had carefully marked with the route the night before.
senses.exampleChinese: 匆忙出发时，我们忘了带前一晚仔细标好路线的地图。

senses.english: a period when many people want something at once
senses.exampleEnglish: The lunch rush began earlier than expected, so the cafe opened its second counter to keep the queue moving.
senses.exampleChinese: 午餐高峰比预期早，咖啡馆因此开放第二个柜台，让队伍持续前进。

senses.english: suitable for serious, official, or important occasions
senses.exampleEnglish: The invitation asked guests to wear formal clothes, although the evening itself was intended to feel relaxed and welcoming.
senses.exampleChinese: 邀请函要求客人穿正式服装，不过晚会本身希望营造轻松、友好的氛围。

senses.english: set of beliefs about a god or gods
senses.exampleEnglish: The course examines how religion has influenced art and architecture, while respecting the different beliefs held by students.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程探讨宗教如何影响艺术和建筑，同时尊重学生持有的不同信仰。

senses.english: person or firm that pays people to work for them
senses.exampleEnglish: Her employer agreed to adjust her working hours so that she could attend an evening course twice a week.
senses.exampleChinese: 雇主同意调整她的工作时间，让她每周能参加两次晚间课程。

senses.english: to refuse to believe, accept, or consider
senses.exampleEnglish: The committee may reject the proposal unless we explain more clearly how its benefits would justify the extra cost.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果我们不更清楚地说明收益如何值得额外投入，委员会可能会拒绝这项提案。

senses.english: a thing not accepted because it does not meet the required standard
senses.exampleEnglish: The factory checked each reject to find out whether the problem came from damaged materials or an incorrect machine setting.
senses.exampleChinese: 工厂检查每件不合格品，确定问题来自材料损坏还是机器设置错误。

senses.english: the second or last mentioned thing
senses.exampleEnglish: We could repair the old printer or buy a new one, but the latter option would cost considerably more.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们可以修旧打印机，也可以买新的，但后一种选择会贵得多。

senses.english: near the end of a period
senses.exampleEnglish: During the latter half of the course, students worked on projects that combined the skills introduced in earlier lessons.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程后半段，学生开展综合运用前面课程所学技能的项目。

senses.english: the second of two people or things just mentioned
senses.exampleEnglish: We could take the bus or walk, but I preferred the latter because the weather had finally become pleasant.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们可以乘公交或步行，但我更喜欢后者，因为天气终于好了。

senses.english: a flat dish used for eating or serving food
senses.exampleEnglish: He carried the plate carefully across the crowded room, trying not to spill the sauce on anyone's clothes.
senses.exampleChinese: 他小心地端着盘子穿过拥挤的房间，尽量不把酱汁洒到别人的衣服上。

senses.english: a flat piece of hard material
senses.exampleEnglish: The metal plate covered the damaged section of floor, keeping the entrance safe until a permanent repair could be arranged.
senses.exampleChinese: 金属板盖住受损地面，让入口保持安全，直到安排永久维修。

senses.english: to cover something with a thin layer of metal
senses.exampleEnglish: The manufacturer will plate the small parts with a protective metal layer before they are fitted into the device.
senses.exampleChinese: 制造商会先给小零件镀上保护金属层，再装进设备。

senses.english: to make something illegal or not allowed
senses.exampleEnglish: The council plans to ban cars from the narrow street during market hours, allowing pedestrians to move around more safely.
senses.exampleChinese: 委员会计划在集市开放时禁止汽车进入狭窄的街道，让行人更安全地通行。

senses.english: an official rule that something is not allowed
senses.exampleEnglish: The ban on cars during market hours made the street quieter and gave shoppers more room between the stalls.
senses.exampleChinese: 集市期间的汽车禁令让街道更安静，也给购物者更多摊位间的空间。

senses.english: to secretly take something that belongs to another
senses.exampleEnglish: The story follows a boy who refuses to steal food, even when he is hungry and has no money.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个故事讲述一个男孩即使饥饿又没钱，也拒绝偷食物的经历。

senses.english: something bought for much less than its usual value
senses.exampleEnglish: The second-hand table was a steal, especially after we discovered that its solid wooden frame needed only a little repair.
senses.exampleChinese: 这张二手桌很划算，尤其发现实木框架只需小修之后。

senses.english: to express opposition through action or words
senses.exampleEnglish: Residents gathered to protest against the closure of their library, arguing that the nearest alternative was too far away.
senses.exampleChinese: 居民聚集起来抗议关闭图书馆，理由是最近的替代图书馆也太远了。

senses.english: an action or statement showing strong disagreement
senses.exampleEnglish: The peaceful protest gave residents a chance to explain why the library mattered to people who could not travel far.
senses.exampleChinese: 和平抗议让居民有机会解释，图书馆为何对不便远行的人重要。

senses.english: to state strongly that something is true, especially in response to blame
senses.exampleEnglish: He continued to protest his innocence, asking the others to check the messages before deciding that he was responsible.
senses.exampleChinese: 他继续坚称清白，请别人先核查消息再判定是他的责任。

senses.english: a written or printed list of topics or words in a particular order
senses.exampleEnglish: The book's index helped me find the section on old bridges without having to read through every chapter.
senses.exampleChinese: 书后的索引帮助我找到介绍古桥的部分，而不必逐章翻阅。

senses.english: a number showing changes in the level of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The report used an index to compare price changes, explaining the starting point before presenting the figures for each year.
senses.exampleChinese: 报告用指数比较价格变化，在给出各年数据前先解释基准点。

senses.english: to make a list that helps people find information
senses.exampleEnglish: The librarian helped index the old letters so that researchers could find references to people and places more easily.
senses.exampleChinese: 图书管理员帮助给旧信编索引，让研究者更容易找到人物和地点的相关内容。

senses.english: feeling unhappy; wishing something hadn't happened
senses.exampleEnglish: She felt sad when the course ended, because the weekly meetings had become an important part of her routine.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程结束时她很难过，因为每周的聚会已经成为她日常生活的重要部分。

senses.english: often; regularly
senses.exampleEnglish: The buses run frequently during the day, although evening passengers sometimes have to wait much longer between services.
senses.exampleChinese: 白天公交车班次很多，不过晚间乘客有时需要等待更长时间。

senses.english: a perfectly round shape or a group arranged in that shape
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher asked everyone to sit in a circle so that each person could see and hear the others clearly.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师请大家围坐成一圈，让每个人都能清楚地看见并听见其他人。

senses.english: to move around something in a curved or circular path
senses.exampleEnglish: The birds continued to circle above the lake while we waited for a clear view from the viewing platform.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们在观景台等候清晰视野时，鸟继续在湖上盘旋。

senses.english: to draw a line around something
senses.exampleEnglish: Please circle the dates when you are available, so that the organiser can choose a time that suits most participants.
senses.exampleChinese: 请圈出你有空的日期，让组织者选择适合多数参与者的时间。

senses.english: a group of people with shared interests or relationships
senses.exampleEnglish: Her circle of friends grew after she joined the club, meeting people whose interests extended well beyond her own work.
senses.exampleChinese: 加入俱乐部后，她的朋友圈扩大了，认识了兴趣远不止于她工作的人。

senses.english: doing things that help someone
senses.exampleEnglish: The receptionist was particularly helpful when we needed to change our booking after the train arrived several hours late.
senses.exampleChinese: 火车晚点几个小时后，我们需要更改预订，接待员在这件事上帮了大忙。

senses.english: to give an order; have control over others
senses.exampleEnglish: The captain continued to command the rescue team calmly, even when the worsening weather forced them to change their original plan.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使天气恶化迫使他们改变原计划，队长仍然冷静地指挥救援队。

senses.english: an order given by someone with authority
senses.exampleEnglish: The captain gave a clear command, allowing the rescue team to move together before the weather became worse.
senses.exampleChinese: 队长发出清晰命令，让救援队在天气恶化前一起行动。

senses.english: knowledge and skill that let someone use something well
senses.exampleEnglish: Her command of English improved through regular discussions, especially when she had to explain a familiar topic in a new way.
senses.exampleChinese: 经常讨论让她英语运用能力提高，尤其是必须换种方式解释熟悉主题时。

senses.english: an instruction given to a computer program
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide explains each command before asking users to type it, reducing the chance that they will change the wrong file.
senses.exampleChinese: 指南先解释每条命令再让用户输入，减少改错文件的可能。

senses.english: to deserve or receive something such as respect or attention
senses.exampleEnglish: Her calm explanation helped command attention, even from people who had arrived at the meeting expecting to disagree.
senses.exampleChinese: 她平静的解释赢得了注意，连那些原本打算反对的人也认真听了。

senses.english: making you like them, as by being good-looking
senses.exampleEnglish: The town became more attractive to visitors after the old harbour was cleaned and several walking routes were improved.
senses.exampleChinese: 老港口被清理、几条步行路线得到改善后，这座城镇对游客更有吸引力了。

senses.english: having a physical or mental illness; not feeling well
senses.exampleEnglish: He felt sick during the rough crossing, so he stayed on deck where the fresh air made him more comfortable.
senses.exampleChinese: 渡海时风浪很大，他觉得恶心，所以待在甲板上，那里新鲜的空气让他舒服些。

senses.english: affected by an illness
senses.exampleEnglish: The school arranged work for the sick student to complete at home, without expecting him to keep the usual pace.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校给生病学生安排在家完成的作业，但不要求他保持平常进度。

senses.english: food or liquid brought back up from the stomach
senses.exampleEnglish: The cleaner dealt with the sick promptly, then closed the area until the floor had been cleaned and dried.
senses.exampleChinese: 清洁员迅速处理呕吐物，然后封闭区域，直到地面清洁并干燥。

senses.english: effect or feeling resulting from an experience
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide's enthusiasm made a strong impression on us, even though we already knew quite a lot about the museum.
senses.exampleChinese: 尽管我们已经对博物馆了解不少，导游的热情仍给我们留下了深刻印象。

senses.english: a performance copying someone's voice or behaviour
senses.exampleEnglish: Her impression of the teacher made the group laugh, although she was careful not to make the imitation unkind.
senses.exampleChinese: 她模仿老师让大家笑了，但她小心避免模仿变得刻薄。

senses.english: a mark made by pressing something into a surface
senses.exampleEnglish: The heavy chair left an impression in the soft floor covering, showing exactly where it had stood for years.
senses.exampleChinese: 沉重椅子在柔软地板材料上留下压痕，显示它多年摆放的位置。

senses.english: not being able to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: We were unable to finish the repairs before dark, so we returned the next morning with better equipment.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们天黑前没能完成维修，于是第二天早晨带着更好的设备回来。

senses.english: to say or do things that are meant to be funny
senses.exampleEnglish: They often joke about getting lost on their first holiday together, although it seemed far less amusing at the time.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们经常拿第一次一起度假时迷路的事开玩笑，虽然当时可没觉得那么好笑。

senses.english: something said or done to make people laugh
senses.exampleEnglish: He told a short joke while we waited, helping the nervous visitors feel more comfortable before their first public performance.
senses.exampleChinese: 等候时他讲了个短笑话，让紧张的访客在首次公开表演前更自在。

senses.chinese: 荒唐的人或事；不值得当真之物
senses.english: something considered ridiculous or not worth taking seriously
senses.exampleEnglish: The timetable had become a joke because buses were so often late that passengers could no longer plan their journeys.
senses.exampleChinese: 时刻表成了笑话，因为公交经常晚点，乘客已无法据此安排出行。

senses.english: the place where we see clouds above us
senses.exampleEnglish: The sky became darker as we approached the coast, so we decided to finish our walk before the storm arrived.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们接近海岸时天空变暗了，所以决定在暴风雨来临前结束步行。

senses.english: a tall post made of stone or wood used as a support in a building; one of two or more blocks of print that appear next to each other on a page
senses.exampleEnglish: A thick stone column supported the roof above the entrance, where visitors waited until the museum was ready to open.
senses.exampleChinese: 一根粗大的石柱支撑着入口上方的屋顶，游客在那里等候博物馆开门。

senses.english: a vertical arrangement of words or numbers
senses.exampleEnglish: Put the dates in the first column and the results in the second, so that readers can compare changes easily.
senses.exampleChinese: 把日期放在第一列、结果放在第二列，让读者容易比较变化。

senses.english: a regular article in a newspaper or magazine
senses.exampleEnglish: Her weekly column discusses local history, often using readers' letters to explain how familiar streets have changed over time.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的每周专栏讨论地方史，常用读者来信说明熟悉街道随时间的变化。

senses.english: operating by use of electricity; digital
senses.exampleEnglish: The hotel sends an electronic confirmation after booking, which guests can show on their phones instead of printing it.
senses.exampleChinese: 酒店在预订后发送电子确认函，客人可以用手机出示，不必打印。

senses.english: to make someone to do, believe, or accept something
senses.exampleEnglish: The school did not want to impose extra costs on families, so it provided the materials needed for the workshop.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校不想给家庭增加额外费用，因此提供了工作坊所需的材料。

senses.english: to officially apply a tax, charge, or punishment
senses.exampleEnglish: The council may impose a fine if businesses continue blocking the pavement after receiving clear instructions to keep it open.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果企业收到明确保持通畅的要求后仍堵住人行道，委员会可能罚款。

senses.english: related to illegal activity; (n) a person who has done a crime
senses.exampleEnglish: The documentary explained how criminal investigations depend on checking evidence carefully rather than simply accepting the first convincing story.
senses.exampleChinese: 这部纪录片解释了刑事调查如何依靠仔细核查证据，而不是直接接受第一个看似可信的说法。

senses.english: a person who has committed a crime
senses.exampleEnglish: The story follows a former criminal who tries to rebuild trust after returning to the town where he grew up.
senses.exampleChinese: 故事讲述一名前罪犯回到成长的城镇后，如何努力重建信任。

senses.english: other than or in addition to
senses.exampleEnglish: Besides offering language classes, the centre organises social events where newcomers can meet local residents and practise speaking.
senses.exampleChinese: 除了提供语言课程，中心还组织社交活动，让新来者认识当地居民并练习口语。

senses.english: in addition to what has already been said
senses.exampleEnglish: We do not need another car; besides, there is nowhere near the house where we could park it safely.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们不需要另一辆车；而且家附近也没有能安全停车的地方。

senses.english: in a correct or suitable way depending on the situation
senses.exampleEnglish: The door would not close properly because a small piece of wood had become trapped underneath it.
senses.exampleChinese: 门关不好，因为一小块木头卡在了门底下。

senses.english: very old; having lived a very long time ago
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide explained how ancient builders moved heavy stones, although some details of their methods are still debated today.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游解释了古代建造者如何搬运巨石，不过他们使用的方法仍有一些细节存在争议。

senses.english: land near the sea or ocean
senses.exampleEnglish: We followed the coast for several kilometres before turning inland towards the village where we had booked a room.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们沿海岸走了几公里，然后转向内陆，前往预订了房间的村庄。

senses.english: to move without using power or effort
senses.exampleEnglish: The driver let the bicycle coast down the gentle slope, keeping both hands ready to use the brakes if necessary.
senses.exampleChinese: 骑车人让自行车顺缓坡滑行，双手随时准备必要时刹车。

senses.english: not well; sick
senses.exampleEnglish: She had been ill for several days, so her colleagues offered to cover the meeting until she felt well enough to return.
senses.exampleChinese: 她病了好几天，因此同事们提出代她开会，直到她恢复到能回来工作。

senses.english: badly or in a way that is not satisfactory
senses.exampleEnglish: The group was ill prepared for the sudden change of weather, despite having plenty of equipment for a normal summer day.
senses.exampleChinese: 尽管带足了普通夏日所需装备，团队对天气突变仍准备不足。

senses.english: a serious problem affecting society or a situation, often in the plural
senses.exampleEnglish: The writer examines social ills through the lives of ordinary families, rather than presenting them only as abstract political questions.
senses.exampleChinese: 作家通过普通家庭的生活考察社会弊病，而非只把它们呈现为抽象政治问题。

senses.english: to hit someone or something using your foot
senses.exampleEnglish: The coach showed the children how to kick the ball accurately before asking them to practise with a partner.
senses.exampleChinese: 教练先教孩子们如何准确地踢球，再让他们两人一组练习。

senses.english: an act of hitting with the foot
senses.exampleEnglish: A careless kick sent the ball over the fence, so the children asked the neighbour politely if they could collect it.
senses.exampleChinese: 不小心的一脚把球踢过围栏，孩子们便礼貌问邻居能否取回。

senses.english: a strong feeling of pleasure or excitement
senses.exampleEnglish: She got a real kick from solving the puzzle, especially because she had nearly given up after the first attempt.
senses.exampleChinese: 解出谜题让她很兴奋，尤其是第一次尝试后她差点放弃。

senses.english: very near in space or time; just next to
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher watched closely while the students used the equipment, ready to help if anyone became unsure about the next step.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生使用设备时，老师在旁边仔细观察，随时帮助不确定下一步操作的学生。

senses.english: with very little distance between people or things
senses.exampleEnglish: The houses stand closely together along the narrow street, leaving only small gardens behind each row of buildings.
senses.exampleChinese: 房屋紧挨着立在窄街旁，每排建筑后面只留了小花园。

senses.english: with a strong connection or similarity
senses.exampleEnglish: The two problems are closely related, so solving one may help us understand why the other keeps occurring.
senses.exampleChinese: 两个问题密切相关，因此解决一个可能帮助我们理解另一个为何反复发生。

senses.english: many things or people
senses.exampleEnglish: The application asks for multiple examples of your experience, so prepare more than one situation that demonstrates your skills.
senses.exampleChinese: 申请要求提供多个经历实例，因此要准备不止一种情境来展示你的技能。

senses.english: a number that can be divided exactly by another number
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher asked us to find a multiple of both numbers before showing a quicker way to compare the fractions.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师先让我们找出两个数的公倍数，再展示比较分数的更快方法。

senses.english: to give way to someone or something else
senses.exampleEnglish: Drivers must yield to pedestrians at the crossing, even when there are no traffic lights controlling the flow of vehicles.
senses.exampleChinese: 即使没有红绿灯控制车流，司机也必须在人行横道处让行人先过。

senses.english: to produce a crop, result, or amount
senses.exampleEnglish: The new approach may yield useful results, but we need several more observations before we can judge its value.
senses.exampleChinese: 新方法可能产生有用结果，但还需更多观察才能判断价值。

senses.english: the amount produced or earned
senses.exampleEnglish: The farmer compared this year's yield with earlier records, checking whether the change in planting had made a difference.
senses.exampleChinese: 农民把今年产量与早期记录比较，核查种植调整是否带来变化。

senses.english: by going through, by way of
senses.exampleEnglish: We travelled to the island via the coastal town, where a regular ferry service connected with the morning train.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们经由海滨小镇前往岛上，那里的定期渡轮与早晨的火车衔接。

senses.english: using a particular method or person
senses.exampleEnglish: The organiser sent the revised timetable via email, asking everyone to confirm that they had received the latest version.
senses.exampleChinese: 组织者通过邮件发送修改后时间表，请大家确认收到最新版本。

senses.english: act or process of writing and passing laws
senses.exampleEnglish: The proposed legislation would require clearer product labels so that customers could compare prices and ingredients more easily.
senses.exampleChinese: 拟议的法律将要求产品标签更加清楚，让顾客更容易比较价格和成分。

senses.english: an area within a country or a state with its own local government
senses.exampleEnglish: The county has several small villages, each of which depends on the same bus service to reach the nearest hospital.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个郡有几个小村庄，每个村庄都依靠同一条公交线路前往最近的医院。

senses.english: appearing or being different
senses.exampleEnglish: The two sisters were quite unlike in character, although both enjoyed travelling and were curious about other people's lives.
senses.exampleChinese: 两姐妹的性格很不一样，不过她们都喜欢旅行，并对别人的生活充满好奇。

senses.english: different from a particular person or thing
senses.exampleEnglish: Unlike her brother, she enjoys planning every detail before travelling, although both are happy to change plans when necessary.
senses.exampleChinese: 与哥哥不同，她喜欢旅行前计划每个细节，但二人都愿意必要时改计划。

senses.english: not typical of someone's usual behaviour
senses.exampleEnglish: It was unlike him to miss a meeting without sending a message, so we checked whether he needed help.
senses.exampleChinese: 不开会又不发消息不像他的作风，因此我们查问他是否需要帮助。

senses.english: able to move from one place to another
senses.exampleEnglish: The mobile library visits remote villages every fortnight, allowing residents to borrow books without making a long journey into town.
senses.exampleChinese: 流动图书馆每两周走访偏远村庄，让居民不用长途进城也能借书。

senses.english: a portable telephone connected to a wireless network
senses.exampleEnglish: She left her mobile at home by mistake, so she used the station's information desk to contact her family.
senses.exampleChinese: 她不小心把手机留在家里，因此借助车站咨询台联系了家人。

senses.english: a person who helps another, usually as a job
senses.exampleEnglish: The shop assistant checked the stockroom after the customer asked whether the same jacket was available in another size.
senses.exampleChinese: 顾客询问同款夹克是否有其他尺码后，店员到仓库进行了查看。

senses.english: to start and carry out a plan or government policy; (n) tool
senses.exampleEnglish: The school plans to implement the new timetable gradually, giving families enough time to adjust their travel arrangements.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校计划逐步实施新的时间表，给家庭足够的时间调整出行安排。

senses.english: a tool used for a particular activity
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum displayed a farming implement beside a photograph that showed how villagers had used it before modern machinery arrived.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆在一张旧照片旁展出农具，照片展示现代机械出现前村民如何使用它。

senses.english: drawing showing information in a clear way
senses.exampleEnglish: The chart showed how visitor numbers changed through the year, making the difference between summer and winter immediately clear.
senses.exampleChinese: 图表显示了一年中游客数量的变化，让夏季与冬季的差异一目了然。

senses.english: a list ranking popular recordings or other items
senses.exampleEnglish: The song entered the charts after a local performance was shared online and attracted listeners from other countries.
senses.exampleChinese: 本地演出的线上分享吸引其他国家听众后，这首歌进入排行榜。

senses.english: to record or show how something changes
senses.exampleEnglish: The students will chart the plant's growth over six weeks, using the same ruler and recording each measurement carefully.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生会用同一把尺子记录植物六周的生长，并仔细记下每次测量。

senses.english: to be associated or connected with
senses.exampleEnglish: Please attach the receipt to your application so that the office can confirm how much you paid for the course.
senses.exampleChinese: 请在申请中附上收据，以便办公室确认你支付了多少课程费用。

senses.english: any place of pain and suffering
senses.exampleEnglish: In the novel, the abandoned town becomes a kind of hell for people who cannot find food, shelter, or safety.
senses.exampleChinese: 小说中，对那些找不到食物、住所或安全保障的人来说，这座废弃城镇成了一种地狱。

senses.english: a place believed in some religions to punish people after death
senses.exampleEnglish: The painting shows a traditional image of hell, which the guide explains in relation to the beliefs of its original audience.
senses.exampleChinese: 画作展示传统地狱图景，导游结合最初观众的信仰进行解释。

senses.english: used informally to express anger or surprise
senses.exampleEnglish: “Hell, I forgot the tickets,” he said, then calmly checked whether the booking could be shown on his phone instead.
senses.exampleChinese: “糟了，我忘带票了，”他说，随后冷静查看能否改用手机出示预订。

senses.english: every place
senses.exampleEnglish: After the strong wind, leaves were scattered everywhere, including inside the shed where the door had not been closed properly.
senses.exampleChinese: 大风过后，到处都是散落的树叶，连门没关好的棚屋里也有。

senses.english: to suggest what should be done
senses.exampleEnglish: The receptionist can advise you on the best way to reach the museum, depending on how much time you have.
senses.exampleChinese: 接待员能根据你有多少时间，建议你选择最合适的方式去博物馆。

senses.english: to officially tell someone information
senses.exampleEnglish: The school will advise parents of any change in the departure time, so please keep your contact details up to date.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校会通知家长出发时间的任何变化，因此请更新联系方式。

senses.english: all the people who live in a house; a family
senses.exampleEnglish: Each household received a leaflet explaining how to separate recyclable materials before the new collection service began operating.
senses.exampleChinese: 在新的收集服务开始前，每户家庭都收到了一份说明如何分类可回收物的传单。

senses.english: relating to the home and everyday family needs
senses.exampleEnglish: The family compared household expenses before deciding which changes would save money without making daily life unnecessarily difficult.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个家庭先比较日常开支，再决定哪些改变能省钱又不让生活无谓困难。

senses.english: to accept that something is true
senses.exampleEnglish: The manager was willing to acknowledge the mistake and explain what the company would do to prevent it happening again.
senses.exampleChinese: 经理愿意承认错误，并解释公司将采取什么措施防止同样的事再次发生。

senses.english: to tell someone that a message or item has been received
senses.exampleEnglish: Please acknowledge this message when it arrives, so that the organiser knows everyone has seen the revised meeting place.
senses.exampleChinese: 收到后请确认这条消息，让组织者知道大家看到修改后的集合地点。

senses.english: to show that you have noticed or recognised someone
senses.exampleEnglish: She paused to acknowledge her former teacher with a smile before continuing towards the entrance with the rest of the group.
senses.exampleChinese: 她停下微笑向以前的老师致意，再与其他组员走向入口。

senses.english: to express appreciation for someone's help or achievement
senses.exampleEnglish: The report will acknowledge the volunteers who collected the information, rather than giving all the credit to the project leader.
senses.exampleChinese: 报告会认可收集信息的志愿者，而不把功劳全归项目负责人。

senses.english: to give something to someone because of their good work
senses.exampleEnglish: The organisers wanted to reward volunteers for their efforts, so they arranged a special evening at the end of the festival.
senses.exampleChinese: 组织者想感谢志愿者的付出，因此在节日结束时为他们安排了一个特别的晚会。

senses.english: something good received for an action, effort, or achievement
senses.exampleEnglish: The best reward was seeing the garden used by families who had helped turn an empty space into somewhere welcoming.
senses.exampleChinese: 最好的回报，是看到协助改造空地的家庭开始使用这个宜人花园。

senses.english: the direction where the sun rises
senses.exampleEnglish: The garden faces east, which means the kitchen receives plenty of natural light during the early part of the morning.
senses.exampleChinese: 花园朝东，因此早晨较早的时候，厨房能照到充足的自然光。

senses.english: in or facing the east
senses.exampleEnglish: The east window catches the morning light, making the room a pleasant place to read before the rest of the house wakes.
senses.exampleChinese: 东窗接住晨光，让房间在家人醒来前成为宜人的阅读地点。

senses.english: towards the east
senses.exampleEnglish: We travelled east after crossing the river, following the signs until the road reached the small village near the hills.
senses.exampleChinese: 过河后我们向东行驶，沿路牌来到山边的小村庄。

senses.english: something people wear to cover their heads for fashion or protection
senses.exampleEnglish: She packed a wide hat for the walking holiday, knowing that there would be little shade along the coastal path.
senses.exampleChinese: 她知道沿海步道上几乎没有树荫，因此为徒步假期准备了一顶宽檐帽。

senses.chinese: 学院的，学术的；（n）学者，大学教师
senses.english: related to education or school; (n) educator who works at a college or university
senses.exampleEnglish: The course combines academic study with practical experience, allowing students to test ideas they have discussed in the classroom.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程把学术学习与实践经验结合起来，让学生检验在课堂上讨论过的想法。

senses.english: someone who teaches or researches at a university
senses.exampleEnglish: The academic explained her research in ordinary language, allowing visitors with little background knowledge to take part in the discussion.
senses.exampleChinese: 这位学者用通俗语言解释研究，让缺少背景知识的访客也能参与讨论。

senses.english: concerned with ideas rather than immediate practical use
senses.exampleEnglish: The question was not merely academic, because the answer would influence how the school used its limited resources.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个问题不只是理论讨论，因为答案会影响学校如何使用有限资源。

senses.english: a person who can vote in an election
senses.exampleEnglish: Each voter received information about the candidates before entering the room where the local election was taking place.
senses.exampleChinese: 每位选民进入举行地方选举的房间前，都收到了候选人的相关信息。

senses.english: at or during the same time; in the meantime
senses.exampleEnglish: The adults prepared the picnic; meanwhile, the children checked the map and chose a suitable place beside the river.
senses.exampleChinese: 大人们准备野餐，与此同时，孩子们查看地图，在河边选了一处合适的地点。

senses.english: in addition to what has been said
senses.exampleEnglish: The new building uses less energy than the old one; furthermore, it has better access for people with limited mobility.
senses.exampleChinese: 新楼比旧楼更节能，而且为行动不便的人提供了更好的通行条件。

senses.english: to say that someone has done something bad or wrong
senses.exampleEnglish: You should not accuse someone of taking your belongings until you have checked whether they were moved for a good reason.
senses.exampleChinese: 指责别人拿了你的物品之前，应先核查物品是否因合理原因被挪走。

senses.english: related to science
senses.exampleEnglish: The students learned that a scientific explanation should be supported by evidence that other people can examine and test.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生们学到，科学解释应当有证据支持，而且这些证据能被其他人检查和验证。

senses.english: money paid to workers for the hours they worked
senses.exampleEnglish: The advertised wage seemed reasonable, but she asked how many hours she would be expected to work each week.
senses.exampleChinese: 广告上给出的工资似乎合理，但她问清楚了每周预计要工作多少小时。

senses.english: to organise and carry on a war or campaign
senses.exampleEnglish: The residents decided to wage a peaceful campaign against the closure, collecting stories that showed why the library mattered.
senses.exampleChinese: 居民决定和平反对关闭图书馆，收集故事说明它为何重要。

senses.english: a time when you are not in a place where you should be
senses.exampleEnglish: In the teacher's absence, the assistant explained the task and made sure that every student had the materials they needed.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师不在时，助教解释了任务，并确保每位学生都有所需的材料。

senses.english: the fact that something is missing or unavailable
senses.exampleEnglish: The absence of clear signs made the building difficult to navigate, especially for visitors arriving there for the first time.
senses.exampleChinese: 缺少清楚标牌让建筑难以辨路，尤其是初次到访的人。

senses.english: to build or create something
senses.exampleEnglish: The volunteers helped construct a simple shelter beside the sports field so that spectators could stay dry during matches.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者帮助在运动场旁搭建了一个简易遮雨棚，让观众在比赛时保持干爽。

senses.english: to say an opinion or make a comment about something
senses.exampleEnglish: Several visitors remark on how peaceful the village feels, even though it is only a short train journey from the city.
senses.exampleChinese: 几位游客都提到这个村庄多么宁静，尽管从城市乘火车很快就能到达。

senses.english: a spoken or written comment
senses.exampleEnglish: Her final remark made us think again about the plan, because it raised a practical issue nobody had mentioned.
senses.exampleChinese: 她最后的话让我们重新思考计划，因为它提出了无人提过的实际问题。

senses.english: liquid or pills used to treat illness or pain; the study of treating illness or pain
senses.exampleEnglish: The nurse explained how to store the medicine safely, away from heat and out of the reach of young children.
senses.exampleChinese: 护士解释了如何安全存放药物，要避开高温，并放在幼儿够不到的地方。

senses.english: the science and practice of treating illness
senses.exampleEnglish: She became interested in medicine after meeting a doctor who explained how research could improve the care patients received.
senses.exampleChinese: 遇到一位解释研究如何改善病人护理的医生后，她对医学产生兴趣。

senses.english: a teacher of high rank in a university or college
senses.exampleEnglish: The professor encouraged students to question the evidence rather than repeat an argument simply because it appeared in a textbook.
senses.exampleChinese: 教授鼓励学生质疑证据，而不是因为某个论点出现在教科书里就照搬。

senses.english: not common or usual
senses.exampleEnglish: It is rare to find such a quiet beach near the city, especially during the busiest weeks of the summer.
senses.exampleChinese: 在城市附近找到这样安静的海滩很少见，尤其是在夏季最繁忙的几个星期。

senses.english: cooked only a little, especially when describing meat
senses.exampleEnglish: He asked for the steak rare, while his sister preferred hers cooked longer and served with extra vegetables.
senses.exampleChinese: 他要了偏生的牛排，姐姐则喜欢多煎一会儿并加些蔬菜。

senses.english: plan, aim, or purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: My intention was to clarify the schedule, not to suggest that anyone had deliberately caused the delay in our work.
senses.exampleChinese: 我的本意是说清楚时间安排，而不是暗示有人故意拖延了我们的工作。

senses.english: a group of twelve people or things
senses.exampleEnglish: We bought a dozen rolls from the bakery, which was enough to make lunch for everyone taking part in the trip.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们从面包店买了十二个面包卷，足够给所有参加旅行的人做午餐。

senses.english: an official agreement that ends an argument or fight between people or groups
senses.exampleEnglish: After weeks of discussion, both sides reached a settlement that allowed the community centre to remain open under new management.
senses.exampleChinese: 经过数周讨论，双方达成了协议，让社区中心在新的管理下继续开放。

senses.english: a place where people have established a community
senses.exampleEnglish: The small settlement grew around the railway station, where workers and their families found transport and regular employment.
senses.exampleChinese: 小聚居地围绕火车站发展，工人及家属在那里获得交通和稳定工作。

senses.english: the act of paying money that is owed
senses.exampleEnglish: We requested settlement of the account before the end of the month, attaching copies of the original invoices.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们要求月底前结清账款，并附上原始发票副本。

senses.english: a space between two things
senses.exampleEnglish: There was a small gap beneath the door, allowing cold air to enter even when the room was otherwise warm.
senses.exampleChinese: 门下有一道小缝，即使屋里其他地方暖和，冷空气也能钻进来。

senses.english: a difference in level or amount
senses.exampleEnglish: The new programme aims to reduce the gap between experienced students and those who have had fewer chances to practise.
senses.exampleChinese: 新项目旨在缩小经验丰富学生与练习机会较少者之间的差距。

senses.english: a period between events
senses.exampleEnglish: There was a long gap between the two trains, so we had enough time to eat and explore the nearby square.
senses.exampleChinese: 两班火车间隔很长，因此我们有足够时间吃饭并逛附近广场。

senses.english: by or among a large number of people
senses.exampleEnglish: The book is widely used in language classes because its examples encourage students to discuss situations from their own lives.
senses.exampleChinese: 这本书广泛用于语言课，因为书中的例子鼓励学生讨论自身生活中的情境。

senses.english: lowest number or amount that is possible
senses.exampleEnglish: The course requires a minimum of six participants, so it cannot begin until two more people have registered.
senses.exampleChinese: 这门课程至少需要六人参加，因此还要再有两人报名才能开课。

senses.english: being the smallest amount allowed or required
senses.exampleEnglish: The course has a minimum age requirement because some activities involve equipment designed for older participants rather than young children.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程有最低年龄要求，因为某些活动涉及为较大参与者而非幼儿设计的设备。

senses.english: in or toward the north
senses.exampleEnglish: The northern part of the island is quieter, with fewer hotels and several walking routes that pass through small fishing villages.
senses.exampleChinese: 岛的北部更安静，酒店较少，还有几条穿过小渔村的步行路线。

senses.english: land that a person owns
senses.exampleEnglish: The old estate includes farmland and woodland, much of which is now open to visitors who follow the marked paths.
senses.exampleChinese: 这片古老庄园包括农田和林地，其中许多地方如今向沿标记路线行走的访客开放。

senses.english: all the property and money someone owns, especially after death
senses.exampleEnglish: The family asked an adviser to explain the estate before deciding how the old house and remaining savings should be managed.
senses.exampleChinese: 家人请顾问说明遗产，再决定如何管理老屋和剩余存款。

senses.english: an area developed for a group of buildings with a shared purpose
senses.exampleEnglish: The housing estate has a shared garden where residents can meet while their children play safely away from the road.
senses.exampleChinese: 住宅区有共用花园，孩子能远离道路安全玩耍，居民也能聚会。

senses.english: a car with a large storage area behind the back seats
senses.exampleEnglish: They chose an estate because it had enough space for camping equipment without making the rear seats difficult to use.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们选择旅行车，因为能放下露营设备，又不影响后座使用。

senses.english: in an equal, similar, or identical way
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher divided the materials equally among the groups so that no team would have an advantage during the activity.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师把材料平均分给各组，让任何一组都不会在活动中占有优势。

senses.english: to show something that is usually hidden, covered, or protected
senses.exampleEnglish: The investigation helped expose serious problems in the booking system, which had remained hidden because customers rarely received clear explanations.
senses.exampleChinese: 调查帮助揭露了预订系统的严重问题，这些问题一直隐藏着，因为顾客很少得到明确解释。

senses.english: to make someone experience something, especially a risk or influence
senses.exampleEnglish: The visit will expose students to different ways of working, giving them ideas they may not meet in their usual classes.
senses.exampleChinese: 参观会让学生接触不同工作方法，获得平常课堂未必遇到的想法。

senses.english: to remove something that covers or protects another thing
senses.exampleEnglish: Removing the old paint began to expose the original wood, which was in better condition than the carpenter expected.
senses.exampleChinese: 去除旧漆后，原木开始露出，状况比木匠预料的更好。

senses.english: living; not dead
senses.exampleEnglish: The missing plant was still alive, although it had received very little water while we were away from home.
senses.exampleChinese: 那株被遗忘的植物仍然活着，尽管我们不在家期间，它几乎没得到浇水。

senses.english: continuing to exist with energy or interest
senses.exampleEnglish: Regular meetings kept the project alive during the winter, even when cold weather prevented the volunteers from working outside.
senses.exampleChinese: 定期开会让项目冬季仍有活力，即使寒冷天气让志愿者无法户外工作。

senses.english: to close something
senses.exampleEnglish: Please shut the window before you leave, as strong wind may blow rain onto the papers on my desk.
senses.exampleChinese: 离开前请关上窗户，因为大风可能把雨吹到我桌上的文件上。

senses.english: not open
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum was shut when we arrived, although the sign outside still showed the opening hours from the previous season.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们到时博物馆关着，尽管外面标牌仍显示上一季的开放时间。

senses.english: a win in a war, game, or competition
senses.exampleEnglish: Their victory was especially satisfying because the team had worked hard to improve after losing the same competition the previous year.
senses.exampleChinese: 他们的胜利格外令人满意，因为球队在去年同一比赛失利后，一直努力提高。

senses.english: to find an answer or way to handle a problem
senses.exampleEnglish: We arranged a meeting to resolve the problem before it caused further delays to the work being done by other teams.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们安排了一次会议来解决问题，以免进一步耽误其他团队正在进行的工作。

senses.english: to make a firm decision to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: She resolved to keep practising after the difficult lesson, reminding herself that progress was not always easy to notice.
senses.exampleChinese: 困难一课后，她决心继续练习，提醒自己进步不总是容易察觉。

senses.english: strong determination to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: The setback strengthened their resolve to finish the project, especially after local families offered more practical help.
senses.exampleChinese: 挫折加强了他们完成项目的决心，尤其是本地家庭提供更多实际帮助后。

senses.english: a person whose job is to give opinions about books, movies, or other forms of art
senses.exampleEnglish: The critic praised the actors' performances but argued that the final scene failed to explain the main character's decision clearly.
senses.exampleChinese: 评论家赞扬了演员的表演，但认为最后一幕没有清楚解释主角的决定。

senses.english: someone who strongly disapproves of a person, plan, or situation
senses.exampleEnglish: A critic of the proposal asked the council to explain how the extra traffic would affect nearby families.
senses.exampleChinese: 一位提案反对者要求委员会解释额外交通会如何影响附近家庭。

senses.english: having the ability to change or vary
senses.exampleEnglish: The weather is highly variable in the mountains, so walkers should be prepared for conditions to change within a few hours.
senses.exampleChinese: 山区天气变化很大，因此徒步者应该准备好应对几小时内发生的天气变化。

senses.english: a quantity or factor that can change
senses.exampleEnglish: The students changed only one variable at a time, allowing them to see which adjustment had affected the result.
senses.exampleChinese: 学生每次只改变一个变量，以便看清哪项调整影响了结果。

senses.english: huge; very big; very large
senses.exampleEnglish: The project required an enormous amount of patience, particularly when the team had to repeat work that had already been completed.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个项目需要极大的耐心，尤其是在团队不得不重做已经完成的工作时。

senses.english: tasting like sugar; containing sugar
senses.exampleEnglish: The fruit was naturally sweet, so we decided not to add sugar when preparing the dessert for our guests.
senses.exampleChinese: 水果本身很甜，因此为客人制作甜点时，我们决定不再加糖。

senses.english: kind, pleasant, and caring towards others
senses.exampleEnglish: It was sweet of her to leave a note for the new neighbours, offering help before they had even unpacked.
senses.exampleChinese: 新邻居还没拆行李，她就留便条主动帮忙，真体贴。

senses.english: very pleasant to hear or smell
senses.exampleEnglish: A sweet smell came from the garden as we opened the window, making the room feel fresher after the warm afternoon.
senses.exampleChinese: 打开窗户时，花园飘来芳香，让闷热下午后的房间清新些。

senses.english: a small piece of sweet food, often eaten between meals
senses.exampleEnglish: The children chose one sweet each from the jar, then returned to the table to finish their craft project.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们每人从罐子选了一颗糖，再回桌边完成手工项目。

senses.english: a sweet dish served at the end of a meal
senses.exampleEnglish: For the sweet, our host served a fruit pudding that had been prepared earlier and left to cool by the window.
senses.exampleChinese: 餐后甜点，主人端上了提前做好并放在窗旁冷却的水果布丁。

senses.english: lasting forever; not temporary or changing
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition was so successful that the museum decided to give it a permanent place rather than remove it after summer.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览非常成功，因此博物馆决定永久保留，而不是在夏天过后撤展。

senses.english: a feeling such as sadness, anger, or love
senses.exampleEnglish: Her voice carried a strong emotion when she described returning to the town where she had spent her childhood.
senses.exampleChinese: 她描述重返童年生活过的城镇时，声音里流露出强烈的情感。

senses.english: to follow and try to catch something; to try to get something
senses.exampleEnglish: She decided to pursue a career in design after discovering that she enjoyed solving practical problems through drawing and making things.
senses.exampleChinese: 发现自己喜欢通过绘画和制作物品解决实际问题后，她决定从事设计工作。

senses.english: to follow someone or something in order to catch it
senses.exampleEnglish: The wildlife team had to pursue the injured animal carefully, keeping enough distance to avoid making it more frightened.
senses.exampleChinese: 野生动物团队小心追踪受伤动物，保持足够距离，避免让它更害怕。

senses.english: to continue an activity or investigation
senses.exampleEnglish: We decided to pursue the matter further after discovering that several other customers had reported exactly the same problem.
senses.exampleChinese: 发现其他几位顾客报告了完全相同的问题后，我们决定进一步追究。

senses.english: greater in height than average
senses.exampleEnglish: The tall trees along the path provided welcome shade, although their roots sometimes made the ground difficult to walk on.
senses.exampleChinese: 路旁的高树带来了宜人的树荫，尽管树根有时使地面变得难走。

senses.english: to strongly persuade someone to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: The organiser will urge people to book early, because the smaller rooms usually fill up several weeks before the event.
senses.exampleChinese: 组织者会力劝大家尽早预订，因为较小的房间通常在活动开始前几周就会订满。

senses.english: a strong desire to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: She felt an urge to interrupt, but waited until the speaker had finished explaining the reason for the delay.
senses.exampleChinese: 她有冲动想打断，但等到发言者解释完延误原因。

senses.english: someone who wants to harm another
senses.exampleEnglish: The two characters begin the story as enemies, but working towards the same goal gradually changes how they see each other.
senses.exampleChinese: 故事开始时两个角色是敌人，但朝共同目标努力逐渐改变了他们对彼此的看法。

senses.english: to officially choose a person for a job, position
senses.exampleEnglish: The committee will appoint a new manager after interviewing candidates who have experience running similar projects in other towns.
senses.exampleChinese: 委员会将面试在其他城镇负责过类似项目的候选人，然后任命一位新经理。

senses.english: the white liquid produced by females to feed their babies
senses.exampleEnglish: We kept the milk in a cool bag during the journey because there was no refrigerator at the campsite.
senses.exampleChinese: 旅途中我们把牛奶放在保冷袋里，因为营地没有冰箱。

senses.english: a white liquid food made from certain plants
senses.exampleEnglish: The cafe offers oat milk for customers who prefer it, although the menu clearly lists all the available options.
senses.exampleChinese: 咖啡馆给偏好它的顾客提供燕麦奶，同时菜单清楚列出所有选项。

senses.english: to take milk from an animal
senses.exampleEnglish: The farmer showed us how to milk a cow gently, explaining why a calm routine mattered for the animals.
senses.exampleChinese: 农民展示如何轻柔地挤牛奶，解释平静的日常安排为何对动物重要。

senses.english: to gain as much benefit as possible from a situation
senses.exampleEnglish: The character tried to milk his small success for attention, repeating the story whenever new visitors arrived at the club.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个角色想尽量利用小小成功博取关注，每有新访客到俱乐部就重复故事。

senses.english: the natural ability of a person to do something well
senses.exampleEnglish: Her talent for explaining difficult ideas became clear when the younger students began asking her to help with their homework.
senses.exampleChinese: 低年级学生开始请她辅导作业时，她解释复杂概念的天赋显现了出来。

senses.english: people who have strong natural abilities
senses.exampleEnglish: The company wanted to attract new talent by offering training and meaningful work, rather than relying only on a higher salary.
senses.exampleChinese: 公司想以培训和有意义的工作吸引新人才，而不只依靠更高工资。

senses.english: to use your nose to sense something
senses.exampleEnglish: You could smell the fresh bread from the street, which made it difficult to walk past the bakery without stopping.
senses.exampleChinese: 在街上就能闻到新鲜面包的香味，让人很难路过面包店而不停下来。

senses.english: to have a particular odour
senses.exampleEnglish: The room began to smell fresh after we opened the windows and removed the old carpet that had become damp.
senses.exampleChinese: 开窗并移走受潮旧地毯后，房间开始闻起来清新。

senses.english: the quality of something noticed through the nose
senses.exampleEnglish: The smell of fresh bread reached us before we saw the bakery hidden behind the small row of shops.
senses.exampleChinese: 还没看到藏在小排商店后面的面包店，新鲜面包香就飘来了。

senses.english: the ability to notice odours
senses.exampleEnglish: The guide explained how a dog's sense of smell helps it notice details that people might pass without recognising.
senses.exampleChinese: 导游解释狗的嗅觉如何帮助它察觉人们经过时可能忽略的细节。

senses.english: happening or coming earlier in time
senses.exampleEnglish: No prior experience is necessary for the course, because the tutor introduces each skill before asking participants to practise it.
senses.exampleChinese: 参加课程不需要先前经验，因为导师会先介绍每项技能，再让学员练习。

senses.english: something that is important and must be done before other things
senses.exampleEnglish: Improving access to the library became a priority after residents explained how difficult the steps were for older visitors.
senses.exampleChinese: 居民说明台阶给年长访客带来的困难后，改善图书馆通行条件成了优先事项。

senses.english: the right to be considered or go before others
senses.exampleEnglish: Pedestrians have priority at this crossing, so drivers must slow down even when the road ahead appears clear.
senses.exampleChinese: 行人在这个路口有优先权，因此即使前路似乎畅通，司机也须减速。

senses.english: connected to the internet
senses.exampleEnglish: The course is available online, allowing people who live far from the college to participate without making long journeys.
senses.exampleChinese: 这门课程可以在线学习，让远离学院的人不用长途出行也能参加。

senses.english: using the internet
senses.exampleEnglish: We booked the tickets online before travelling, which saved us from waiting in the long queue beside the main entrance.
senses.exampleChinese: 出发前我们在网上订票，省去了在主入口旁排长队。

senses.english: a group of words that forms a unit and expresses a single meaning
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher asked us to choose a phrase from the article and explain how its meaning changed in a different context.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师让我们从文章中选一个短语，解释它在不同语境下意思如何变化。

senses.english: to express something using particular words
senses.exampleEnglish: Try to phrase your request politely so that the reader understands what you need without feeling criticised or pressured.
senses.exampleChinese: 尽量礼貌表达请求，让读者明白需要，又不感到被批评或施压。

senses.chinese: （飞机，宇宙飞船或船舶的）驾驶员
senses.english: a person who controls an airplane, spacecraft, or boat
senses.exampleEnglish: The pilot explained that strong winds might delay our landing, although the aircraft had enough fuel to wait safely.
senses.exampleChinese: 飞行员解释说，强风可能推迟降落，不过飞机有足够燃料安全等候。

senses.english: a small trial used to test whether a larger plan should continue
senses.exampleEnglish: The school ran a pilot with one class before deciding whether the new reading programme should include every year group.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校先在一个班试点，再决定新阅读项目是否覆盖每个年级。

senses.english: done first on a small scale to test an idea
senses.exampleEnglish: The pilot project revealed several practical problems that the team could fix before inviting the wider community to participate.
senses.exampleChinese: 试点项目发现几个实际问题，团队可在邀请更广泛社区参与前修正。

senses.english: to control an aircraft or guide a ship
senses.exampleEnglish: She learned to pilot small aircraft before joining a team that transported supplies to communities far from the main roads.
senses.exampleChinese: 她先学会驾驶小型飞机，后来加入向远离主路社区运输物资的团队。

senses.english: to test a new plan on a small scale
senses.exampleEnglish: The council will pilot the service in two villages, collecting feedback before deciding whether to extend it across the region.
senses.exampleChinese: 委员会将在两个村庄试行服务，收集反馈后决定是否推广全地区。

senses.english: in a good situation or condition; not likely to change
senses.exampleEnglish: The table became stable again after we replaced the damaged leg, so it could safely hold the heavy equipment.
senses.exampleChinese: 更换损坏的桌腿后，桌子重新稳固了，可以安全地承载重型设备。

senses.english: a building where horses are kept
senses.exampleEnglish: The old stable now houses an exhibition, although visitors can still see where the horses once stood beside the courtyard.
senses.exampleChinese: 旧马厩如今设有展览，但游客仍能看到马匹曾在庭院旁站立的位置。

senses.english: to keep a horse in a stable
senses.exampleEnglish: The riders stable their horses near the training ground, allowing the animals to rest before the next morning's activities.
senses.exampleChinese: 骑手把马安置在训练场附近的马厩，让它们在次晨活动前休息。

senses.english: only, simply, or nothing more than
senses.exampleEnglish: He was not merely asking for more money; he wanted the organisation to explain how the existing budget had been used.
senses.exampleChinese: 他不只是在要求更多经费，还想让机构解释现有预算的使用情况。

senses.english: a formal agreement or statement decided by a group of people
senses.exampleEnglish: The committee passed a resolution to protect the old library, even though several members disagreed about how to fund the repairs.
senses.exampleChinese: 尽管几位成员对维修资金来源有分歧，委员会仍通过了一项保护旧图书馆的决议。

senses.english: strong determination to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: Her resolution impressed the other volunteers, particularly when she continued working patiently after several attempts had failed.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的决心令其他志愿者印象深刻，尤其是多次失败后仍耐心工作。

senses.english: the process or result of solving a problem or disagreement
senses.exampleEnglish: The resolution of the dispute depended on both sides accepting that the original instructions had not been clear enough.
senses.exampleChinese: 争议的解决取决于双方承认原先说明不够清楚。

senses.english: the degree of detail in an image or screen
senses.exampleEnglish: A higher resolution made the map easier to read, although the larger image took longer to open on my phone.
senses.exampleChinese: 更高分辨率让地图易读，但较大图片在手机上打开更慢。

senses.english: to give and exchange information
senses.exampleEnglish: The team learned to communicate more clearly after discovering that small misunderstandings had caused several avoidable delays in their work.
senses.exampleChinese: 发现小误会导致工作中几次本可避免的延误后，团队学会了更清楚地沟通。

senses.english: physical or emotional harm or damage that a person experiences
senses.exampleEnglish: A minor injury kept him away from training for a week, although he still attended matches to support his teammates.
senses.exampleChinese: 一处轻伤让他一周无法训练，不过他仍去看比赛，为队友加油。

senses.english: being very large in size or amount
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum holds a vast collection of photographs, many of which show places that have changed almost beyond recognition.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆收藏了大量照片，其中许多拍摄的地方已经变化得几乎认不出来。

senses.english: an event at which an object or group of objects is shown to the public
senses.exampleEnglish: The exhibition brought together work by local artists, giving visitors a chance to compare different ways of showing the same landscape.
senses.exampleChinese: 展览汇集了当地艺术家的作品，让观众有机会比较表现同一景观的不同方法。

senses.english: a company making or growing a certain product
senses.exampleEnglish: The local producer sells most of its cheese directly to shops, which helps keep transport distances short and products fresh.
senses.exampleChinese: 当地生产商把大部分奶酪直接卖给商店，这有助于缩短运输距离、保持产品新鲜。

senses.english: someone who organises the making of a film, play, or recording
senses.exampleEnglish: The producer arranged rehearsals and equipment so that the performers could focus on telling the story clearly to the audience.
senses.exampleChinese: 制作人安排排练和设备，让演员专注向观众清楚讲故事。

senses.english: having to do with a particular area
senses.exampleEnglish: The regional bus service connects small villages with the town, where residents can reach schools, shops, and the hospital.
senses.exampleChinese: 区域公交服务把小村庄与城镇连接起来，居民能在那里前往学校、商店和医院。

senses.english: done without delay; straight away
senses.exampleEnglish: The problem required immediate attention because even a short delay could damage the equipment and interrupt the whole project.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个问题需要立即处理，因为即使短暂延误也可能损坏设备，中断整个项目。

senses.english: closest in place or relationship
senses.exampleEnglish: Only immediate family attended the small ceremony, while friends were invited to a larger celebration later in the summer.
senses.exampleChinese: 只有直系亲属参加小仪式，朋友则受邀参加夏天稍后的较大庆祝会。

senses.english: acting or happening without another step in between
senses.exampleEnglish: The immediate cause of the delay was a broken signal, although the report also examined problems in the maintenance schedule.
senses.exampleChinese: 延误的直接原因是信号损坏，但报告也研究了维护安排的问题。

senses.english: something that happens, especially if it is bad or unusual
senses.exampleEnglish: The manager recorded the incident carefully, including what had happened before the alarm and how the staff had responded.
senses.exampleChinese: 经理仔细记录了这一事件，包括警报前发生的情况，以及员工如何作出回应。

senses.english: the time when you are a child
senses.exampleEnglish: Her memories of childhood included long afternoons in the garden, where her grandparents taught her the names of common birds.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的童年回忆包括在花园里度过的漫长下午，祖父母在那里教她认识常见鸟类。

senses.english: an early version of writing that may still be changed
senses.exampleEnglish: Please read the first draft before our meeting so that we can spend the time discussing changes rather than explaining the main idea.
senses.exampleChinese: 请会前阅读初稿，开会时便可讨论修改而非解释主旨。

senses.english: to write an early version of a document
senses.exampleEnglish: The secretary will draft a letter explaining the decision before the committee checks whether the wording is clear and fair.
senses.exampleChinese: 秘书将先起草解释决定的信，再由委员会检查措辞是否清楚公正。

senses.english: a flow of cool air through a room, called a draught in British English
senses.exampleEnglish: A cold draft came through the damaged window, so we moved the chairs closer to the centre of the room.
senses.exampleChinese: 冷风从破窗吹进来，所以我们把椅子移向房间中央。

senses.english: to slide out of position or fall to the ground by accident
senses.exampleEnglish: Be careful not to slip on the wet steps, especially where leaves have collected near the bottom of the path.
senses.exampleChinese: 小心别在湿台阶上滑倒，尤其是小路底端附近积了树叶的地方。

senses.english: a small mistake or an accidental sliding movement
senses.exampleEnglish: One small slip in the instructions caused confusion because the visitors thought the afternoon session began an hour earlier.
senses.exampleChinese: 说明中一处小疏漏引起困惑，游客以为下午场提前一小时开始。

senses.english: to move somewhere quietly or put something somewhere quickly
senses.exampleEnglish: She managed to slip out of the meeting without disturbing anyone because she had already explained why she needed to leave early.
senses.exampleChinese: 她已解释需早退，因此悄悄离开会议，没有打扰别人。

senses.english: to go somewhere with someone
senses.exampleEnglish: A guide will accompany the group through the older part of the building, where visitors cannot explore on their own.
senses.exampleChinese: 一位导游将陪同参观团经过大楼的老旧部分，访客不能在那里自行游览。

senses.english: someone who is active in politics
senses.exampleEnglish: The politician promised to listen to local concerns before announcing whether she would support the proposed changes to public transport.
senses.exampleChinese: 这位政治家承诺先倾听当地居民的担忧，再宣布是否支持拟议的公共交通改革。

senses.english: having a strong feeling about something that you dislike very much
senses.exampleEnglish: She was angry about the delay, but she waited until she felt calmer before discussing it with the manager.
senses.exampleChinese: 她对延误很生气，但等到平静些后，才和经理讨论这件事。

senses.english: to hit something to get people's attention
senses.exampleEnglish: Please knock before entering the office, because someone may be having a private conversation with a member of staff.
senses.exampleChinese: 进入办公室前请先敲门，因为里面可能有人正在与工作人员私下交谈。

senses.english: a small object made by a plant from which a new plant can grow; the beginning of something
senses.exampleEnglish: The children planted a seed in each pot, then recorded how the plants changed when they received different amounts of light.
senses.exampleChinese: 孩子们在每个花盆里种下一粒种子，再记录光照量不同时植物的变化。

senses.english: the beginning of something that may develop, or a highly ranked competitor
senses.exampleEnglish: A short conversation planted the seed of an idea that eventually became the village's most popular annual event.
senses.exampleChinese: 一次简短谈话埋下想法的种子，最终成为村里最受欢迎的年度活动。

senses.english: money an employee is paid each year
senses.exampleEnglish: She accepted a slightly lower salary because the new job offered better training and a much shorter journey from home.
senses.exampleChinese: 她接受了略低的薪水，因为新工作提供更好的培训，而且通勤距离短得多。

senses.english: to explain with examples, to make it easier to understand
senses.exampleEnglish: The teacher used a simple map to illustrate how the river had influenced the growth of the town over time.
senses.exampleChinese: 老师用一张简单的地图，说明这条河如何随着时间推移影响了城镇的发展。

senses.english: to suggest something, without saying it directly
senses.exampleEnglish: Her message did not imply that the project was finished; it simply confirmed that the first stage had been approved.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的信息并不是暗示项目已完成，而只是确认第一阶段已经获批。

senses.english: the first meal of the day
senses.exampleEnglish: We ate breakfast earlier than usual so that we could catch the first bus and avoid the busiest walking paths.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们比平时更早吃早餐，以便赶上首班公交车，避开最拥挤的步道。

senses.english: continuing for a limited time, not permanent
senses.exampleEnglish: The family found temporary accommodation near the school while repairs were carried out on the roof of their own home.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家人在学校附近找到了临时住所，等待自己家的屋顶维修完成。

senses.english: open to new ideas; believing government should actively support social needs
senses.exampleEnglish: Her parents held liberal views about education, encouraging her to explore different subjects before choosing a particular career path.
senses.exampleChinese: 她的父母教育观念开明，鼓励她先探索不同学科，再选择具体的职业方向。

senses.english: accepting different ideas and allowing people considerable freedom
senses.exampleEnglish: The school takes a liberal approach to discussion, encouraging students to question ideas respectfully rather than simply agree with their teachers.
senses.exampleChinese: 学校以开放方式讨论，鼓励学生尊重地质疑观点而非只赞同老师。

senses.english: a large area of water surrounded by land
senses.exampleEnglish: A path runs around the lake, giving visitors several places to stop and watch the birds without disturbing them.
senses.exampleChinese: 一条小路环绕湖泊，为访客提供了几处可以停下来观察鸟类而不打扰它们的地方。

senses.english: to get the necessary skill or knowledge to do a particular job or activity
senses.exampleEnglish: She hopes the course will help her qualify as an instructor, allowing her to teach activities she has enjoyed for years.
senses.exampleChinese: 她希望这门课程能帮助她获得教练资格，从而教授自己喜欢多年的活动。

senses.english: wanting to win or to be better than others
senses.exampleEnglish: He became less competitive after learning that the club valued teamwork and regular participation more than winning every match.
senses.exampleChinese: 得知俱乐部更重视合作和经常参与，而非赢下每场比赛后，他不再那么争强好胜。

senses.english: based on truth or fact or reality
senses.exampleEnglish: The village felt truly peaceful once the daytime visitors had left and only the sound of the river remained.
senses.exampleChinese: 白天的游客离开后，村里只剩下河水声，这时才显得真正宁静。

senses.english: what you say when you meet someone; hello
senses.exampleEnglish: She said hi to the new neighbours before asking whether they needed any help carrying boxes into their flat.
senses.exampleChinese: 她先向新邻居打了招呼，然后问他们是否需要帮忙把箱子搬进公寓。

senses.english: color of lemons or the sun
senses.exampleEnglish: We chose yellow curtains for the small kitchen because they made the room feel warmer on cloudy winter mornings.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们给小厨房选了黄色窗帘，因为它们让阴沉冬日早晨的房间显得更温暖。

senses.english: the usual way of behaving; something often repeated
senses.exampleEnglish: He developed the habit of writing a short plan each evening, which made the following morning feel much less rushed.
senses.exampleChinese: 他养成了每天晚上写简短计划的习惯，让第二天早晨不再那么匆忙。

senses.english: a flat round object
senses.exampleEnglish: The display showed how a spinning disk can appear almost still when its speed matches the flashing light above it.
senses.exampleChinese: 演示展示了旋转圆盘的速度与上方闪光灯匹配时，圆盘如何看起来几乎静止。

senses.english: the central part of a fruit containing its seeds
senses.exampleEnglish: Remove the apple's core before cutting the fruit into small pieces, as the seeds and harder centre are not needed.
senses.exampleChinese: 把苹果切成小块前先去核，因为不需要种子和较硬的中心部分。

senses.english: most central or important to something
senses.exampleEnglish: The training covers the core skills that every volunteer needs before allowing them to choose activities matching their own interests.
senses.exampleChinese: 培训先教授每位志愿者必备的核心技能，再让他们选感兴趣的活动。

senses.english: related to deep feelings
senses.exampleEnglish: The final scene was emotional because the characters finally understood what their long separation had meant to each other.
senses.exampleChinese: 最后一幕令人动情，因为角色们终于明白，多年的分离对彼此意味着什么。

senses.english: a machine that can fly
senses.exampleEnglish: The aircraft remained on the ground while engineers checked a warning light that had appeared before the scheduled departure.
senses.exampleChinese: 原定起飞前出现一盏警示灯，因此飞机留在地面，等待工程师检查。

senses.english: the type of person you really are
senses.exampleEnglish: The story shows how a change of circumstances can reveal a person's true self more clearly than their everyday behaviour.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个故事展示了环境的改变如何比日常行为更清楚地显露一个人的真实自我。

senses.english: a type of hardy material that is usually hard and shiny that can be used to make things, such as iron, gold, or steel
senses.exampleEnglish: The metal frame was heavier than the wooden one, but it was better suited to supporting the large shelves.
senses.exampleChinese: 金属框架比木框架更重，但更适合支撑大型架子。

senses.english: state of being present, alive, or real
senses.exampleEnglish: The discovery confirmed the existence of an earlier settlement, although researchers still had many questions about the people who lived there.
senses.exampleChinese: 这一发现证实了更早聚居地的存在，不过研究者对曾住在那里的人仍有很多疑问。

senses.english: hard pieces of a body that form the frame of an animal
senses.exampleEnglish: The museum displayed a large bone from an ancient animal, alongside a drawing showing where it fitted into the body.
senses.exampleChinese: 博物馆展示了一块古代动物的大骨头，旁边配有示意图，说明它在身体中的位置。

senses.english: a rectangular piece of wood, metal, etc., that is a part of something bigger; a group of people who discuss something
senses.exampleEnglish: The builder removed a wooden panel to reach the pipes, then replaced it carefully once the repair was finished.
senses.exampleChinese: 工人拆下一块木板以便接近管道，维修完成后又小心地把它装回原处。

senses.english: a group chosen to discuss a subject or judge something
senses.exampleEnglish: A panel of local experts will judge the designs after each team explains how its idea could benefit the community.
senses.exampleChinese: 各队说明设计如何造福社区后，本地专家组将评审方案。

senses.english: a flat part of a surface or a board containing controls
senses.exampleEnglish: The control panel displays a warning whenever the machine needs attention, making it easier for operators to respond quickly.
senses.exampleChinese: 机器需检修时控制面板会显示警告，方便操作员及时应对。

senses.english: main; most important; best quality
senses.exampleEnglish: The prime reason for the change was to make the service more reliable, rather than to attract a larger number of customers.
senses.exampleChinese: 这次调整的主要原因是提高服务可靠性，而不是吸引更多顾客。

senses.english: the time you arranged to meet someone or do something
senses.exampleEnglish: I made an appointment with the adviser so that we could discuss my plans without interruptions from the busy reception area.
senses.exampleChinese: 我与顾问约好了时间，以便在不受繁忙接待区干扰的情况下讨论我的计划。

senses.english: the act of choosing someone for a job or position
senses.exampleEnglish: Her appointment as director was welcomed by staff who had worked with her during the museum's most difficult period.
senses.exampleChinese: 员工欢迎任命她为馆长，他们曾在博物馆最困难时与她共事。

senses.english: to stress the items that are important
senses.exampleEnglish: The coach tried to emphasize the importance of regular practice rather than letting the children focus only on winning competitions.
senses.exampleChinese: 教练努力强调规律练习的重要性，而不是让孩子们只关注赢得比赛。

senses.english: largest or greatest
senses.exampleEnglish: The room can hold a maximum of twenty people, so we will need another space if more participants register.
senses.exampleChinese: 这个房间最多能容纳二十人，因此如果有更多人报名，就需要另找场地。

senses.english: in a way that produces the result you want
senses.exampleEnglish: The team worked more effectively once everyone understood which tasks they were responsible for and when those tasks had to be finished.
senses.exampleChinese: 当每个人都清楚自己的任务及截止时间后，团队的工作更有效率了。

senses.english: in or to another or different place
senses.exampleEnglish: The cafe was full, so we decided to look elsewhere rather than wait outside in the cold for a table.
senses.exampleChinese: 咖啡馆满了，所以我们决定去别处找，而不是在外面的寒风里等桌位。

senses.english: to take the trouble to do something
senses.exampleEnglish: I did not bother to print the map because I knew the route well enough to find the building without it.
senses.exampleChinese: 我没有费心打印地图，因为我足够熟悉路线，不用地图也能找到那栋楼。

senses.english: ability to decide or act upon things yourself without depending on someone else
senses.exampleEnglish: She showed initiative by contacting the supplier herself, rather than waiting for someone else to notice that the delivery was late.
senses.exampleChinese: 她主动联系了供应商，而没有等别人发现交货已经延误。

senses.english: having a thin edge or point that is able to cut
senses.exampleEnglish: Keep the sharp knife away from the edge of the table, where someone could knock it onto the floor accidentally.
senses.exampleChinese: 把锋利的刀放得离桌边远一点，以免有人不小心把它碰到地上。

senses.english: quick to notice or understand things
senses.exampleEnglish: Her sharp eye for detail helped the team identify a mistake that would otherwise have delayed the whole project.
senses.exampleChinese: 她敏锐的观察力帮助团队发现了本会耽误整个项目的错误。

senses.english: sudden, steep, strong, or unpleasantly clear
senses.exampleEnglish: There was a sharp increase in enquiries after the article appeared, so extra volunteers were needed to answer calls.
senses.exampleChinese: 文章发表后咨询急增，需要额外志愿者接电话。

senses.english: the food and drink a person usually has
senses.exampleEnglish: His usual diet includes plenty of vegetables, although he finds it harder to prepare balanced meals when travelling for work.
senses.exampleChinese: 他平常的饮食包含大量蔬菜，不过出差时，他觉得准备均衡的饭菜更困难。

senses.english: a movement; the way something moves
senses.exampleEnglish: The slow motion of the boat made it easier to observe the birds without disturbing them along the riverbank.
senses.exampleChinese: 船缓慢移动，让我们更容易观察河岸边的鸟类，而不打扰它们。

senses.english: color between black and white
senses.exampleEnglish: The gray clouds gradually covered the hills, warning us that the clear weather might not last until the end of our walk.
senses.exampleChinese: 灰云渐渐遮住山丘，提醒我们晴朗天气可能无法持续到徒步结束。

senses.english: a very common, light, strong material that can be formed into many different shapes and is made by a chemical process
senses.exampleEnglish: We replaced several plastic containers with reusable glass jars, although we kept the lighter ones for carrying food on trips.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们把几个塑料容器换成可重复使用的玻璃罐，不过保留了较轻的容器供旅行携带食物。

senses.english: to make more difficult
senses.exampleEnglish: Adding too many optional features could complicate the design and make the product harder for new users to understand.
senses.exampleChinese: 加入太多可选功能可能使设计复杂化，让新用户更难理解产品。

senses.english: the teaching of self-control through instruction and practice
senses.exampleEnglish: Learning an instrument requires discipline, because progress depends on regular practice even when the same exercise no longer feels exciting.
senses.exampleChinese: 学习乐器需要自律，因为即使同样的练习不再令人兴奋，进步仍取决于坚持练习。

senses.english: control of behaviour through rules, habits, or training
senses.exampleEnglish: Regular practice requires discipline, especially when progress feels slow and there is nobody nearby to remind you to continue.
senses.exampleChinese: 规律练习需要自律，尤其在进步缓慢又无人提醒坚持时。

senses.english: a particular area of study or professional knowledge
senses.exampleEnglish: The course brings together several disciplines so that students can examine the same problem from different practical and theoretical perspectives.
senses.exampleChinese: 课程结合多个学科，让学生从不同实践和理论角度考察同一问题。

senses.english: to not meet the expectations of others or yourself
senses.exampleEnglish: We did not want to disappoint the visitors, so we found an alternative activity when the outdoor performance was cancelled.
senses.exampleChinese: 户外演出取消后，我们不想让游客失望，因此找了一个替代活动。

senses.english: a person who manages you, or is in charge of you at work
senses.exampleEnglish: Her boss encouraged her to explain the problem early, rather than wait until it had become difficult for the whole team.
senses.exampleChinese: 老板鼓励她及早说明问题，而不是等到它给整个团队造成困难。

senses.english: something you believe to be so, but aren't sure of
senses.exampleEnglish: Our plan was based on the assumption that the equipment would arrive before the first group of visitors came.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们的计划建立在这样的假设上：设备会在第一批游客到达之前送到。

senses.english: to make food very cold for storage, become ice, or suddenly stop moving
senses.exampleEnglish: We can freeze the remaining soup in small containers so that volunteers have something ready to eat after future evening sessions.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们可将剩汤分小盒冷冻，供志愿者今后晚间活动后食用。

senses.english: very great in degree
senses.exampleEnglish: The walkers turned back because extreme weather had made the path unsafe, even for people with plenty of experience.
senses.exampleChinese: 徒步者折返了，因为极端天气使小路变得不安全，即使经验丰富的人也不例外。
