senses.english: a long, narrow area that connects one place to another
senses.exampleEnglish: A narrow passage connected the kitchen with the courtyard, allowing staff to carry meals outside without crossing the main dining room.
senses.exampleChinese: 一条狭窄的通道连接着厨房和庭院，让员工不用穿过主餐厅就能把饭菜端到外面。

senses.english: a short section of writing or speech
senses.exampleEnglish: Read the passage carefully before choosing your answer because the writer changes her opinion near the end of the second paragraph.
senses.exampleChinese: 选择答案前细读段落，作者在第二段末改变了观点。

senses.english: a narrow way through a building or the act of moving through something
senses.exampleEnglish: The narrow passage connects the kitchen to the courtyard, where visitors can sit while they wait for the next tour.
senses.exampleChinese: 窄通道连接厨房与庭院，游客可在那里坐等下次导览。

senses.english: an opinion that people have about someone or something based on the past
senses.exampleEnglish: The restaurant built a good reputation by serving fresh local food and responding politely whenever customers suggested improvements.
senses.exampleChinese: 这家餐厅提供新鲜的本地食物，并礼貌回应顾客的改进建议，由此建立了良好声誉。

senses.english: out of a place; forward in time, place, or way
senses.exampleEnglish: The little boat moved back and forth beside the jetty as passengers waited for the river to become calmer.
senses.exampleChinese: 乘客们等待河面平静些的时候，小船在码头旁来回晃动。

senses.english: a formal discussion to reach an agreement
senses.exampleEnglish: The negotiation continued for several weeks because both sides wanted an agreement that would remain workable when circumstances changed.
senses.exampleChinese: 谈判持续了几个星期，因为双方都希望达成一份在情况变化后仍然可行的协议。

senses.english: a part or a set of parts of a machine that has a particular function
senses.exampleEnglish: The locking mechanism was damaged, so the window could not remain securely closed when a strong wind blew against it.
senses.exampleChinese: 锁闭装置损坏了，因此强风吹向窗户时，窗户无法牢固地保持关闭。

senses.english: clothing worn outside over your normal clothes
senses.exampleEnglish: She carried a coat even though the morning was warm, knowing that evenings near the coast could become surprisingly cold.
senses.exampleChinese: 虽然早晨很暖和，她还是带了外套，因为知道海边晚上可能会冷得出乎意料。

senses.english: to cover something with a layer of a substance
senses.exampleEnglish: Coat the wooden surface with oil after cleaning it so that rain is less likely to damage the material.
senses.exampleChinese: 清洁后给木面上油，减少雨水损坏材料的可能。

senses.english: a system of government in which the people of a country can vote to elect who will govern them
senses.exampleEnglish: The lesson explored how democracy allows people to influence public decisions, while also requiring them to respect different opinions.
senses.exampleChinese: 课堂探讨了民主如何让人们影响公共决策，同时也要求人们尊重不同意见。

senses.english: small cloth bag sewn into clothing to hold things
senses.exampleEnglish: He kept the address in his coat pocket so that he could check it quickly without opening his heavy bag.
senses.exampleChinese: 他把地址放在外套口袋里，这样不用打开沉重的包就能迅速查看。

senses.english: to put something in a pocket or take money for yourself
senses.exampleEnglish: He pocketed the change without checking it, then realised later that the assistant had given him too much money.
senses.exampleChinese: 他未核对就把零钱装进口袋，后来才发现店员多找了钱。

senses.english: fortunate; having good things happen to you
senses.exampleEnglish: We were lucky to find a room near the station, especially since most hotels had been booked for the festival.
senses.exampleChinese: 我们很幸运，在车站附近找到了一间房，尤其是大多数酒店都已因节日订满。

senses.english: to hit something hard enough to cause serious damage
senses.exampleEnglish: The loose branch could crash through the window if another strong gust pushed it towards the side of the building.
senses.exampleChinese: 如果再来一阵强风把松动的树枝推向楼的一侧，它可能撞破窗户。

senses.english: to stop operating suddenly or fall sharply in value
senses.exampleEnglish: The program crashed before I could save the final changes, although the earlier version was still available in the backup folder.
senses.exampleChinese: 保存最后修改前程序崩溃了，不过备份文件夹还留着较早版本。

senses.english: careful watching and listening; remark or comment on something you have noticed
senses.exampleEnglish: Careful observation helped the students notice that the plant near the window grew differently from the one kept in shade.
senses.exampleChinese: 仔细观察帮助学生发现，窗边的植物与放在阴处的那株长得不同。

senses.english: the muscles and soft parts of animals or birds that is eaten as food
senses.exampleEnglish: The recipe suggests cooking the meat slowly with vegetables, which allows the flavours to develop without letting the mixture become dry.
senses.exampleChinese: 食谱建议把肉和蔬菜慢慢炖煮，让味道充分融合，同时不让食材变干。

senses.english: the ability to direct all your effort and attention on the one thing you are doing and nothing else
senses.exampleEnglish: The task required complete concentration, so she chose to work in a quiet room where messages and conversations would not interrupt her.
senses.exampleChinese: 这项任务需要全神贯注，因此她选择在安静的房间工作，避免消息和谈话打扰。

senses.english: possible effects or results from an action or event
senses.exampleEnglish: The committee discussed the possible implication of closing the library, particularly for residents who had no internet access at home.
senses.exampleChinese: 委员会讨论了关闭图书馆可能带来的影响，尤其关注家中无法上网的居民。

senses.english: to get the appropriate reward or punishment for the way you behaved or something you did
senses.exampleEnglish: The volunteers deserve recognition for their efforts, especially those who continued helping long after the main event had finished.
senses.exampleChinese: 志愿者的付出值得认可，尤其是那些在主要活动结束很久后仍继续帮忙的人。

senses.english: different from what is ordinary or normal in a way that attracts attention; not usual
senses.exampleEnglish: It was unusual to see the harbour so quiet, until we learned that bad weather had cancelled all the morning ferries.
senses.exampleChinese: 港口如此安静很不寻常，直到我们得知恶劣天气导致早上的渡轮全部取消。

senses.english: to protect against an attack
senses.exampleEnglish: The local team worked hard to defend their lead, although their opponents created several good chances in the final minutes.
senses.exampleChinese: 当地球队努力保住领先优势，尽管对手在最后几分钟创造了几次好机会。

senses.english: something popular or famous for a long time and is considered one of the best of its kind
senses.exampleEnglish: The novel became a classic because its questions about friendship and responsibility continued to interest readers from many different generations.
senses.exampleChinese: 这部小说成了经典，因为其中关于友谊和责任的问题持续吸引着不同世代的读者。

senses.english: a work or example that is widely admired and remains important
senses.exampleEnglish: The novel became a classic because readers from different generations continued to recognise their own experiences in its characters.
senses.exampleChinese: 这部小说成为经典，因为几代读者都能从人物身上看到自己的经历。

senses.english: the male ruler of a country that has a royal family
senses.exampleEnglish: The king appears in several local stories, although historians disagree about how closely those stories reflect what actually happened.
senses.exampleChinese: 国王出现在几个当地传说中，不过历史学家对这些故事在多大程度上反映事实存在分歧。
